source.text: אֵ֠לֶּה הַֽחֻקִּ֣ים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִים֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּשְׁמְר֣וּן לַעֲשׂוֹת֒ בָּאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֩ נָתַ֨ן יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֧י אֲבֹתֶ֛יךָ לְךָ֖ לְרִשְׁתָּ֑הּ כָּל־הַיָּמִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־אַתֶּ֥ם חַיִּ֖ים עַל־הָאֲדָמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: These [are] the statutes and the judgments which you will take care to do in the land which has given Yahweh [the] God of your fathers to you to possess it, all the days which you [are] living on the ground.

en.L: These [are] the statutes and the judgments that you shall be careful to do in the land that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of your fathers, has given you to take possession of it, all the days that you live on the ground.
en.B: These are the statutes and rulings you must be careful to keep in the land that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of your ancestors, has given you to possess, for as long as you live on its soil.
en.R: Here are the laws and rules you must be careful to obey in the land. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of your ancestors, has given it to you to take as your own. Obey them for as long as you live there.

es.L: Estos [son] los estatutos y los juicios que {{plural_you:tendrán|tendréis}} cuidado de hacer en la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de tus padres, te ha dado para tomar posesión de ella, todos los días que {{plural_you:ustedes vivan|vosotros viváis}} sobre el suelo.
es.B: Estos son los estatutos y las normas que {{plural_you:deberán|deberéis}} cuidar de poner en práctica en la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de tus antepasados, te ha dado para que la poseas, mientras {{plural_you:vivan|viváis}} en su suelo.
es.R: Estas son las leyes y las normas que {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} obedecer con cuidado en la tierra. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de tus antepasados, te la ha dado para que la tomes como tuya. {{plural_you:Obedézcanlas|Obedecedlas}} mientras {{plural_you:vivan|viváis}} allí.

fr.L: Voici les prescriptions et les jugements que vous veillerez à pratiquer dans le pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu de tes pères, t’a donné pour en prendre possession, tous les jours que vous vivrez sur le sol.
fr.B: Voici les prescriptions et les règles que vous veillerez à mettre en pratique dans le pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu de tes ancêtres, t’a donné pour que tu en prennes possession, aussi longtemps que vous vivrez sur son sol.
fr.R: Voici les lois et les règles auxquelles vous devez obéir avec soin dans le pays. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu de tes ancêtres, te l’a donné pour que tu le prennes. Obéissez-leur tant que vous y vivrez.

sw.L: Hizi [ndizo] kanuni na hukumu mtakazoangalia kuzitenda katika nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa baba zako, amekupa uimiliki, siku zote mnazoishi juu ya ardhi.
sw.B: Hizi ndizo kanuni na maagizo mnayopaswa kuyashika kwa uangalifu katika nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa mababu zako, amekupa uimiliki, kwa muda wote mtakaoishi katika ardhi yake.
sw.R: Hizi ndizo sheria na maagizo mnayopaswa kuyatii kwa uangalifu katika nchi hiyo. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa mababu zako, amekupa nchi hiyo iwe yako. Yatiini kwa muda wote mtakaoishi huko.

vi.L: Đây [là] các luật lệ và các mạng lệnh mà các ngươi phải cẩn thận làm theo trong xứ mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ phụ ngươi, đã ban cho ngươi để chiếm hữu, trọn những ngày các ngươi sống trên đất.
vi.B: Đây là các luật lệ và mạng lệnh anh em phải cẩn thận làm theo trong xứ mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ tiên anh em, đã ban cho anh em để chiếm hữu, suốt những ngày anh em sống trên đất ấy.
vi.R: Đây là các luật lệ và mạng lệnh anh em phải cẩn thận vâng giữ trong xứ. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ tiên anh em, đã ban xứ ấy cho anh em làm của mình. Hãy vâng giữ chúng suốt đời anh em sống ở đó.

ko.L: 이것은 너희 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너에게 주어 차지하게 하신 땅에서, 너희가 그 땅 위에 사는 모든 날 동안 지켜 행해야 할 규례와 법도이다.
ko.B: 너희 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희에게 주어 차지하게 하신 땅에서, 너희가 그 땅에 사는 동안 늘 지켜 행해야 할 규례와 법도는 이러하다.
ko.R: 여러분이 그 땅에서 지켜야 할 규례와 법도는 다음과 같습니다. 그 땅은 여러분 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 여러분에게 주셔서 여러분의 것이 되게 하신 땅입니다. 여러분이 그곳에 사는 동안 언제나 이것을 지키십시오.

pt.L: Estes [são] os estatutos e as ordenanças que vocês terão o cuidado de cumprir na terra que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus dos teus pais, te deu para tomares posse dela, todos os dias que vocês viverem sobre o solo.
pt.B: Estes são os estatutos e as ordenanças que vocês terão o cuidado de cumprir na terra que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus dos antepassados de vocês, lhes deu para possuírem, por todo o tempo em que viverem sobre o seu solo.
pt.R: Aqui estão as leis e as regras que vocês devem ter o cuidado de obedecer na terra. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus dos antepassados de vocês, deu essa terra a vocês para ser de vocês. Obedeçam a elas enquanto viverem lá.

am.L: የአባቶችህ አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ትወርሳት ዘንድ በሰጠህ ምድር፣ በምድሪቱ ላይ በሕይወት በምትኖሩባቸው ቀኖች ሁሉ፣ ልታደርጓቸው የምትጠነቀቁላቸው ሥርዓቶችና ፍርዶች እነዚህ [ናቸው]።
am.B: የአባቶችህ አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንድትወርሳት በሰጠህ ምድር፣ በምድሪቱ ላይ በምትኖሩበት ዘመን ሁሉ፣ በጥንቃቄ ልትጠብቋቸው የሚገቡ ሥርዓቶችና ደንቦች እነዚህ ናቸው።
am.R: በምድሪቱ ላይ በጥንቃቄ ልትጠብቋቸው የሚገቡ ሥርዓቶችና ሕጎች እነዚህ ናቸው። የቀድሞ አባቶችህ አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ምድሪቱን የራስህ እንድታደርጋት ሰጥቶሃል። በዚያ በምትኖሩበት ዘመን ሁሉ ጠብቋቸው።

hi.L: ये वे विधियाँ और नियम [हैं] जिनका पालन तुम्हें उस देश में ध्यान से करना है जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे पिताओं के परमेश्वर ने तुम्हें अधिकार में लेने के लिए दिया है, उन सब दिनों जब तक तुम उस भूमि पर जीवित रहो।
hi.B: ये वे विधियाँ और नियम हैं जिनका पालन तुम्हें उस देश में ध्यान से करना है जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे पूर्वजों के परमेश्वर ने तुम्हें अधिकार में लेने के लिए दिया है, जब तक तुम उसकी भूमि पर जीवित रहो।
hi.R: ये वे विधियाँ और नियम हैं जिन्हें तुम्हें उस देश में ध्यान से मानना है। {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे पूर्वजों के परमेश्वर ने वह देश तुम्हें दिया है कि तुम उसे अपना बना लो। जब तक तुम वहाँ जीवित रहो, इन्हें मानते रहना।

ru.L: Вот установления и правила, которые вы должны старательно исполнять в земле, которую {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, Бог твоих отцов, дал тебе, чтобы овладеть ею, все дни, которые вы живёте на земле.
ru.B: Вот установления и правила, которые вы должны старательно соблюдать в земле, которую {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, Бог твоих предков, дал тебе во владение, пока вы живёте на её земле.
ru.R: Вот законы и правила, которые вы должны старательно исполнять в этой земле. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, Бог ваших предков, дал её вам, чтобы она стала вашей. Исполняйте их всё время, пока будете жить там.

ja.L: これらは、あなたの先祖たちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}があなたに与えて所有させられた地で、あなたがたがその土地の上に生きるすべての日々、心して行わなければならない定めと掟である。
ja.B: これは、あなたの先祖たちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}があなたに与えて所有させてくださった地で、あなたがたがその土地に生きている限り、心して守るべき定めと掟である。
ja.R: これから伝えるのは、あなたたちがその土地で注意して守らなければならないきまりとおきてである。あなたの先祖の神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、その土地をあなたに与えて、自分のものにさせてくださった。そこで生きている限り、これを守りなさい。

uk.L: Це постанови і правила, які ви пильнуватимете виконувати в краю, який {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, Бог твоїх батьків, дав тобі, щоб заволодіти ним, по всі дні, які ви живете на землі.
uk.B: Ось постанови й правила, які ви мусите пильно виконувати в краю, що його {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, Бог твоїх предків, дав тобі у володіння, доки ви живете на його землі.
uk.R: Ось закони й правила, які ви мусите уважно виконувати в тому краю. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, Бог твоїх предків, дав його тобі, щоб він став твоїм. Виконуйте їх, доки житимете там.

id.L: Inilah ketetapan dan peraturan yang harus kalian lakukan dengan setia di negeri yang diberikan kepadamu oleh {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah nenek moyangmu, untuk mendudukinya, sepanjang umur kalian hidup di muka bumi.
id.B: Inilah ketetapan dan peraturan yang harus kalian lakukan dengan setia di negeri yang diberikan kepadamu oleh {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah nenek moyangmu, untuk diduduki, selama kalian hidup di tanahnya.
id.R: Inilah hukum dan peraturan yang harus kalian taati dengan sungguh-sungguh di negeri itu. {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah nenek moyang kalian, sudah memberikannya kepada kalian menjadi milik kalian. Taatilah semuanya selama kalian tinggal di sana.

zh.L: 这些是律例和典章，是你们在{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你列祖的{{god_term:神|上帝}}赐给你得为业的地上，在那土地上活着的一切日子，要谨守遵行的。
zh.B: 下面是律例和规定，在{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你祖先的{{god_term:神|上帝}}赐给你占领的地上，你们一生在那片土地上生活的日子，都要谨慎遵行。
zh.R: 下面是你们在那地必须小心遵守的律例和规定。{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你祖先的{{god_term:神|上帝}}已经把那地赐给你，作你自己的地。只要你们住在那里，就要遵守这些律例和规定。

tl.L: Ito ang mga tuntunin at ang mga batas na iingatan ninyong gawin sa lupaing ibinigay sa iyo {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} Diyos ng iyong mga ama upang angkinin ito, sa lahat ng araw na kayo ay nabubuhay sa lupa.
tl.B: Ito ang mga tuntunin at mga batas na dapat ninyong ingatang sundin sa lupaing ibinigay sa inyo {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} Diyos ng inyong mga ninuno upang angkinin, habang kayo ay nabubuhay sa lupain nito.
tl.R: Ito ang mga batas at mga tuntuning dapat ninyong ingatang sundin sa lupain. Ibinigay ito sa inyo {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} Diyos ng inyong mga ninuno upang maging inyo. Sundin ninyo ang mga ito habang kayo ay nabubuhay roon.

pa.L: ਇਹ ਉਹ ਬਿਧੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਨਿਆਂ [ਹਨ] ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਉਸ ਦੇਸ਼ ਵਿੱਚ ਧਿਆਨ ਨਾਲ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਨਾ ਜਿਹੜਾ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਤੇਰੇ {{gender:ਵੱਡ-ਵਡੇਰਿਆਂ|ਪਿਉ-ਦਾਦਿਆਂ}} ਦੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਨੇ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਕਬਜ਼ਾ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਹੈ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਸਾਰੇ ਦਿਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਜਿੰਨਾ ਚਿਰ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਭੂਮੀ ਉੱਤੇ ਜੀਉਂਦੇ ਹੋ।
pa.B: ਇਹ ਉਹ ਬਿਧੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਨਿਆਂ ਹਨ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਉਸ ਦੇਸ਼ ਵਿੱਚ ਧਿਆਨ ਨਾਲ ਮੰਨਣਾ ਹੈ ਜਿਹੜਾ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਤੁਹਾਡੇ {{gender:ਵੱਡ-ਵਡੇਰਿਆਂ|ਪਿਉ-ਦਾਦਿਆਂ}} ਦੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਨੇ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਆਪਣਾ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਲਈ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਹੈ, ਜਦ ਤੱਕ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਧਰਤੀ ਉੱਤੇ ਜੀਉਂਦੇ ਰਹੋ।
pa.R: ਇਹ ਉਹ ਨਿਯਮ ਅਤੇ ਕਾਨੂੰਨ ਹਨ ਜਿਹੜੇ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਧਿਆਨ ਨਾਲ ਮੰਨਣੇ ਚਾਹੀਦੇ ਹਨ। {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਤੁਹਾਡੇ {{gender:ਵੱਡ-ਵਡੇਰਿਆਂ|ਪਿਉ-ਦਾਦਿਆਂ}} ਦੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਇਹ ਦੇਸ਼ ਦੇ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ। ਜਿੰਨਾ ਚਿਰ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਉੱਥੇ ਰਹੋ, ਇਹ ਗੱਲਾਂ ਮੰਨਦੇ ਰਹੋ।

decisions.choice: the statutes and the judgments: the whole body of law that follows
decisions.reason: The pair names the laws Moses promised to teach (4:1, 5:1, 6:1). This verse is the heading of the long section of laws that runs to 26:19, still inside the speech Moses began at 5:1. It closes with the same pair (26:16).

decisions.choice: has given: the gift is certain, though the land is not yet entered
decisions.reason: The verb is in the completed form even though Israel is still east of the Jordan (verse 10). The land is spoken of as already given because God's promise settles it.

decisions.choice: on the ground: on the soil of the land, for as long as you live
decisions.reason: The word is the ground or soil, the farmed earth. "All the days you live on the ground" means for the whole of life in the land (4:10; 31:13); the laws are for life in the land, not only for the journey.

decisions.choice: statutes and judgments / statutes and rulings / laws and rules
decisions.reason: The settled wording for this pair in these books: Literal keeps "judgments", Balanced says "rulings", Readable "laws and rules".

decisions.choice: ancestors
decisions.reason: The "fathers" are Abraham, Isaac and Jacob and the generations after them. Balanced and Readable say "ancestors"; Literal keeps "fathers".

decisions.choice: vocês ... teus pais, te deu (L); vocês throughout (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew opens and closes the verse in the plural and speaks of "your fathers" and "to you" in the singular between. Literal follows it word by word; Balanced and Readable keep the plural of the main clause through the sentence, by the rule for the whole book (6:1).

decisions.choice: os estatutos e as ordenanças (L, B); as leis e as regras (R)
decisions.reason: The heading of the laws (m1) keeps the pair as 4:1 and 6:1 set it for the whole book.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of this chapter
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change; the pronouns for God are the ordinary ones ("እርሱ", "ስሙ").

decisions.choice: "ሥርዓቶችና ፍርዶች" (L), "ሥርዓቶችና ደንቦች" (B), "ሥርዓቶችና ሕጎች" (R) for "the statutes and the judgments"
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch terms list: statute "ሥርዓት"; mishpatim "ፍርዶች" at Literal, "ደንቦች" at Balanced and "ሕጎች" at Readable. Kept through chapters 12-16.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span; honorific "उन्होंने", "वे" for God
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the English deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Hindi, and the Hindi text has no deity_pronoun spans. Respect for God comes from the honorific third person at every level. The same through this chapter.

decisions.choice: "विधियाँ और नियम" at every level
decisions.reason: The statutes and the judgments are the whole body of law that follows (m1). Hindi keeps "विधि" and "नियम", the terms of Exodus and Leviticus, at every level, since both are already plain words; Readable needs no simpler pair where the English says "laws and rules".

decisions.choice: {{god_term:神|上帝}}
decisions.reason: The god_term setting: every word naming the one God is written so that the reader can choose "神" (the default) or "上帝".

decisions.choice: "律例和典章" (L); "律例和规定" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The settled pair for statutes and judgments, as Leviticus 18:4-5 and Deuteronomy 11:32 have it (m1).

decisions.choice: "列祖" (L); "祖先" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English: Literal keeps "fathers", Balanced and Readable say "ancestors"; the English has no setting span, so neither does the Chinese.
The forms for law and command in Deuteronomy (style guide section 11), through this chapter.

decisions.choice: "你" / "你们" as the Hebrew has them
decisions.reason: Moses speaks to Israel now as one and now as many, even within a verse. Every level follows the Hebrew number in each clause; Balanced and Readable keep one form within a sentence where the Hebrew changes in the middle.

decisions.choice: "mga tuntunin at mga batas" (L, B); "mga batas at mga tuntunin" (R)
decisions.reason: The whole body of law that follows (m1), as English (en1).

decisions.choice: "ibinigay"
decisions.reason: The gift is certain, though the land is not yet entered (m2).

decisions.choice: "sa lupa" (L); "sa lupain nito" (B); "roon" (R)
decisions.reason: On the soil of the land, for as long as you live (m3).

decisions.choice: "mga ama" (L); "mga ninuno" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As English (en2).

source.text: אַבֵּ֣ד תְּ֠אַבְּדוּן אֶֽת־כָּל־הַמְּקֹמ֞וֹת אֲשֶׁ֧ר עָֽבְדוּ־שָׁ֣ם הַגּוֹיִ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֛ם יֹרְשִׁ֥ים אֹתָ֖ם אֶת־אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם עַל־הֶהָרִ֤ים הָֽרָמִים֙ וְעַל־הַגְּבָע֔וֹת וְתַ֖חַת כָּל־עֵ֥ץ רַעֲנָן׃

records.literal_gloss: Destroying you shall destroy all the places where served there the nations whom you [are] dispossessing them their gods, on the mountains the high and on the hills and under every tree green.

en.L: You shall utterly destroy all the places where the nations whom you are dispossessing served their gods, on the high mountains and on the hills and under every green tree.
en.B: You must completely destroy all the places where the nations you are driving out worshiped their gods, on the high mountains, on the hills, and under every leafy tree.
en.R: The nations you are driving out worshiped their gods in many places: on high mountains, on hills, and under every green tree. You must destroy all those places completely.

es.L: {{plural_you:Destruirán|Destruiréis}} por completo todos los lugares donde las naciones que {{plural_you:ustedes desposeen|vosotros desposeéis}} sirvieron a sus dioses, sobre los montes altos y sobre las colinas y debajo de todo árbol verde.
es.B: {{plural_you:Deben|Debéis}} destruir completamente todos los lugares donde las naciones que {{plural_you:están expulsando|estáis expulsando}} adoraban a sus dioses: en los montes altos, en las colinas y bajo todo árbol frondoso.
es.R: Las naciones que {{plural_you:ustedes están expulsando|vosotros estáis expulsando}} adoraban a sus dioses en muchos lugares: en montes altos, en colinas y debajo de cada árbol verde. {{plural_you:Deben|Debéis}} destruir por completo todos esos lugares.

fr.L: Vous détruirez entièrement tous les lieux où les nations que vous dépossédez ont servi leurs dieux, sur les hautes montagnes et sur les collines et sous tout arbre vert.
fr.B: Vous devez détruire complètement tous les lieux où les nations que vous chassez ont adoré leurs dieux, sur les hautes montagnes, sur les collines et sous tout arbre au feuillage épais.
fr.R: Les nations que vous chassez adoraient leurs dieux en beaucoup d’endroits : sur les hautes montagnes, sur les collines et sous chaque arbre vert. Vous devez détruire complètement tous ces endroits.

sw.L: Mtaangamiza kabisa mahali pote ambapo mataifa mnayoyanyang'anya [nchi] yaliitumikia miungu yao, juu ya milima mirefu na juu ya vilima na chini ya kila mti mbichi.
sw.B: Ni lazima mpaangamize kabisa mahali pote ambapo mataifa mnayoyafukuza yaliiabudu miungu yao, juu ya milima mirefu, juu ya vilima na chini ya kila mti wenye majani mengi.
sw.R: Mataifa mnayoyafukuza yaliabudu miungu yao mahali pengi: juu ya milima mirefu, juu ya vilima na chini ya kila mti wenye majani mabichi. Ni lazima mpaangamize kabisa mahali hapo pote.

vi.L: Các ngươi phải tiêu hủy hoàn toàn mọi nơi mà các dân tộc các ngươi sắp đuổi đi đã phụng sự các thần của chúng, trên các núi cao, trên các đồi, và dưới mọi cây xanh tươi.
vi.B: Anh em phải phá hủy hoàn toàn mọi nơi mà các dân tộc anh em sắp đuổi đi đã thờ phụng các thần của chúng, trên núi cao, trên đồi, và dưới mọi cây xanh rậm lá.
vi.R: Các dân tộc anh em sắp đuổi đi đã thờ các thần của chúng ở nhiều nơi: trên núi cao, trên đồi, và dưới mọi cây xanh. Anh em phải phá hủy hoàn toàn tất cả những nơi ấy.

ko.L: 너희가 쫓아낼 민족들이 그들의 신들을 섬긴 모든 곳, 곧 높은 산들 위와 언덕들 위와 모든 푸른 나무 아래에 있는 곳을 너희는 반드시 없애 버려라.
ko.B: 너희가 쫓아낼 민족들이 그들의 신들을 섬기던 곳은, 높은 산 위든 언덕 위든 잎이 무성한 나무 아래든 모두 남김없이 없애 버려라.
ko.R: 여러분이 쫓아낼 민족들은 여러 곳에서 그들의 신들을 섬겼습니다. 높은 산 위에서도, 언덕 위에서도, 푸른 나무 아래에서도 섬겼습니다. 그런 곳은 모두 완전히 없애 버려야 합니다.

pt.L: Destruirão completamente todos os lugares onde as nações que vocês estão desapossando serviram os seus deuses, sobre os montes altos, e sobre as colinas, e debaixo de toda árvore verdejante.
pt.B: Destruam completamente todos os lugares onde as nações que vocês estão expulsando adoravam os seus deuses, nos montes altos, nas colinas e debaixo de toda árvore frondosa.
pt.R: As nações que vocês estão expulsando adoravam os seus deuses em muitos lugares: nos montes altos, nas colinas e debaixo de toda árvore verde. Vocês devem destruir completamente todos esses lugares.

am.L: የምትወርሷቸው ሕዝቦች አማልክታቸውን ያገለገሉባቸውን ስፍራዎች ሁሉ፣ በረጃጅም ተራሮች ላይ፣ በኮረብቶችም ላይ፣ ከለመለመ ዛፍም ሁሉ በታች፣ ፈጽማችሁ ታጠፏቸዋላችሁ።
am.B: የምታስወጧቸው ሕዝቦች በረጃጅም ተራሮች ላይ፣ በኮረብቶች ላይና ቅጠሉ በለመለመ ዛፍ ሁሉ ሥር አማልክታቸውን ያመለኩባቸውን ስፍራዎች ሁሉ ፈጽማችሁ አጥፉ።
am.R: የምታባርሯቸው ሕዝቦች አማልክታቸውን በብዙ ስፍራዎች ያመልኩ ነበር፤ በረጃጅም ተራሮች ላይ፣ በኮረብቶች ላይና በለመለመ ዛፍ ሁሉ ሥር። እነዚያን ስፍራዎች ሁሉ ፈጽማችሁ አጥፉ።

hi.L: तुम उन सब स्थानों को पूरी तरह नाश कर देना जहाँ वे जातियाँ, जिन्हें तुम बेदख़ल कर रहे हो, ऊँचे पहाड़ों पर और पहाड़ियों पर और हर हरे वृक्ष के नीचे अपने देवताओं की सेवा करती थीं।
hi.B: जिन जातियों को तुम निकाल रहे हो, वे जिन-जिन स्थानों पर अपने देवताओं की पूजा करती थीं, ऊँचे पहाड़ों पर, पहाड़ियों पर और हर घने वृक्ष के नीचे, उन सबको तुम पूरी तरह नाश कर देना।
hi.R: जिन जातियों को तुम निकाल रहे हो, वे बहुत-सी जगहों पर अपने देवताओं की पूजा करती थीं: ऊँचे पहाड़ों पर, पहाड़ियों पर और हर हरे पेड़ के नीचे। तुम उन सब जगहों को पूरी तरह नाश कर देना।

ru.L: Истребите, истребите все места, где народы, которых вы изгоняете, служили своим богам, на высоких горах, и на холмах, и под всяким зелёным деревом.
ru.B: Полностью уничтожьте все места, где народы, которых вы изгоняете, поклонялись своим богам: на высоких горах, на холмах и под каждым ветвистым деревом.
ru.R: Народы, которых вы прогоняете, поклонялись своим богам во многих местах: на высоких горах, на холмах и под каждым зелёным деревом. Вы должны полностью уничтожить все эти места.

ja.L: あなたがたは、あなたがたが追い払おうとしている国々がその神々に仕えたすべての場所を、高い山々の上でも、丘の上でも、すべての青々とした木の下でも、ことごとく破壊しなければならない。
ja.B: あなたがたが追い払おうとしている国々がその神々を拝んだ場所は、高い山の上であれ、丘の上であれ、葉の茂った木の下であれ、すべて徹底的に破壊しなさい。
ja.R: あなたたちが追い払う国々は、多くの場所で自分たちの神々を拝んでいた。高い山の上や丘の上、また、緑の葉が茂るどの木の下でも拝んでいた。そういう場所を、すべて完全にこわしなさい。

uk.L: Конче знищіть усі місця, де народи, яких ви виганяєте, служили своїм богам, на високих горах, і на пагорбах, і під кожним зеленим деревом.
uk.B: Ви мусите цілком знищити всі місця, де народи, яких ви виганяєте, служили своїм богам: на високих горах, на пагорбах і під кожним розлогим деревом.
uk.R: Народи, яких ви виганяєте, поклонялися своїм богам у багатьох місцях: на високих горах, на пагорбах і під кожним зеленим деревом. Ви мусите повністю знищити всі ці місця.

id.L: Kalian harus benar-benar membinasakan segala tempat, tempat bangsa-bangsa yang akan kalian halau itu beribadah kepada allah-allah mereka, di atas gunung-gunung yang tinggi dan di atas bukit-bukit dan di bawah setiap pohon yang rimbun.
id.B: Kalian harus membinasakan sama sekali segala tempat bangsa-bangsa yang akan kalian halau itu beribadah kepada allah-allah mereka, di atas gunung-gunung yang tinggi, di atas bukit-bukit, dan di bawah setiap pohon yang rimbun.
id.R: Bangsa-bangsa yang akan kalian usir itu menyembah allah-allah mereka di banyak tempat: di atas gunung yang tinggi, di atas bukit, dan di bawah setiap pohon yang rimbun. Kalian harus menghancurkan semua tempat itu sama sekali.

zh.L: 你们要彻底毁灭你们要取代的列国事奉他们神明的一切地方，无论是在高山上，在小山上，还是在各样青翠的树下。
zh.B: 你们要把你们要赶出的列国敬拜他们神明的一切地方完全毁掉，无论是在高山上、山冈上，还是在每一棵枝叶茂盛的树下。
zh.R: 你们要赶出的那些民族在许多地方敬拜他们的神明：在高山上，在小山上，在每一棵绿树下。你们必须把这些地方完全毁掉。

tl.L: Lubos ninyong wawasakin ang lahat ng lugar na pinaglingkuran ng mga bansang inyong pinalalayas sa kanilang mga diyos, sa matataas na bundok at sa mga burol at sa ilalim ng bawat luntiang punongkahoy.
tl.B: Lubos ninyong wasakin ang lahat ng lugar kung saan sinamba ng mga bansang inyong pinalalayas ang kanilang mga diyos, sa matataas na bundok, sa mga burol, at sa ilalim ng bawat mayabong na punongkahoy.
tl.R: Sinamba ng mga bansang inyong pinalalayas ang kanilang mga diyos sa maraming lugar: sa matataas na bundok, sa mga burol, at sa ilalim ng bawat luntiang punongkahoy. Dapat ninyong wasakin nang lubusan ang lahat ng lugar na iyon.

pa.L: ਤੁਸੀਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਸਾਰੀਆਂ ਥਾਵਾਂ ਦਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਨਾਸ ਕਰਨਾ ਜਿੱਥੇ ਉਹ ਕੌਮਾਂ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਕੱਢ ਰਹੇ ਹੋ ਆਪਣੇ ਦੇਵਤਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਦੀਆਂ ਸਨ, ਉੱਚੇ ਪਹਾੜਾਂ ਉੱਤੇ ਅਤੇ ਟਿੱਬਿਆਂ ਉੱਤੇ ਅਤੇ ਹਰ ਹਰੇ ਰੁੱਖ ਦੇ ਹੇਠ।
pa.B: ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਕੌਮਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਕੱਢ ਰਹੇ ਹੋ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਉੱਚੇ ਪਹਾੜਾਂ ਉੱਤੇ, ਟਿੱਬਿਆਂ ਉੱਤੇ ਅਤੇ ਹਰ ਸੰਘਣੇ ਹਰੇ ਰੁੱਖ ਹੇਠ ਜਿੱਥੇ ਵੀ ਆਪਣੇ ਦੇਵਤਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਪੂਜਾ ਕੀਤੀ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਸਾਰੀਆਂ ਥਾਵਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਪੂਰੀ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਮਿਟਾ ਦਿਓ।
pa.R: ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਕੌਮਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਕੱਢਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਹੋ, ਉਹ ਆਪਣੇ ਦੇਵਤਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਪੂਜਾ ਉੱਚੇ ਪਹਾੜਾਂ ਉੱਤੇ, ਪਹਾੜੀਆਂ ਉੱਤੇ ਅਤੇ ਹਰੇ-ਭਰੇ ਰੁੱਖਾਂ ਹੇਠ ਕਰਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ। ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਸਾਰੀਆਂ ਥਾਵਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਪੂਰੀ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਤਬਾਹ ਕਰ ਦਿਓ।

decisions.choice: destroying you shall destroy: destroy completely
decisions.reason: The verb is doubled for emphasis. It is the ordinary verb "destroy", used of the places of worship and their objects, not the word for devoting to destruction used of the nations themselves (7:2).

decisions.choice: high mountains, hills, green trees: the open-air shrines of the land
decisions.reason: Hilltops and large leafy trees were favored places for worship in Canaan. The prophets and the histories name them again and again as places of false worship (1 Kings 14:23; 2 Kings 17:10; Jeremiah 2:20; Hosea 4:13).

decisions.choice: served: worshiped
decisions.reason: To "serve" a god is to worship it with offerings and rites. The same verb is used of serving the LORD (10:12).

decisions.choice: worshiped / driving out
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "worshiped" for "served", which is its sense here. The verb for taking the nations' place is "dispossess" at Literal and "drive out" at Balanced and Readable, as settled for Deuteronomy.

decisions.choice: destruir completamente (every level)
decisions.reason: The doubled ordinary verb "destroy" (m1), not the verb of the ban, which the book renders "consagrar à destruição" (7:2); so Portuguese says "destruir completamente" and keeps the two apart.

decisions.choice: "ሕዝቦች" for the nations (goyim) at every level; "የምትወርሷቸው" (L), "የምታስወጧቸው" (B), "የምታባርሯቸው" (R) for "whom you dispossess"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verb is "inherit, take possession of" with the people as its object; Literal keeps it, Balanced and Readable say what it means for the people, as the English does. "ሕዝቦች" (not "ሕዝቦች") for goyim, as Genesis and Deuteronomy 7 in Amharic.

decisions.choice: abad (destroy): "ことごとく破壊する" (Literal), "徹底的に破壊する" (Balanced), "完全にこわす" (Readable)
decisions.reason: "滅ぼし尽くす" is kept for cherem (DEU 7:2); here the verb is about tearing down places of worship.

decisions.choice: "取代" (L); "赶出" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English: Literal says that Israel takes the nations' place ("dispossess"), Balanced and Readable "drive out", as in 11:23.

decisions.choice: "他们神明", no god_term span
decisions.reason: The nations' gods are written plainly.

decisions.choice: "敬拜" (B, R); "事奉" (L)
decisions.reason: "Served" means worshiped here (m3), as the English Balanced and Readable say.

decisions.choice: "Lubos ninyong wawasakin"
decisions.reason: Destroy completely (m1).

decisions.choice: "matataas na bundok ... burol ... luntiang punongkahoy"
decisions.reason: The open-air shrines of the land (m2).

decisions.choice: "pinaglingkuran" (L); "sinamba" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Worshiped (m3), as English (en1).

source.text: וְנִתַּצְתֶּ֣ם אֶת־מִזְבּחֹתָ֗םוְשִׁבַּרְתֶּם֙ אֶת־מַצֵּ֣בֹתָ֔ם וַאֲשֵֽׁרֵיהֶם֙ תִּשְׂרְפ֣וּן בָּאֵ֔שׁ וּפְסִילֵ֥י אֱלֹֽהֵיהֶ֖ם תְּגַדֵּע֑וּן וְאִבַּדְתֶּ֣ם אֶת־שְׁמָ֔ם מִן־הַמָּק֖וֹם הַהֽוּא׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will pull down their altars, and you will shatter their pillars, and their Asherah poles you will burn with fire, and [the] carved images of their gods you will cut down, and you will destroy their name from the place the that.

en.L: And you shall tear down their altars and smash their pillars, and their Asherah poles you shall burn with fire, and the carved images of their gods you shall cut down, and you shall destroy their name from that place.
en.B: Tear down their altars, smash their sacred stones, burn their Asherah poles, cut down the carved images of their gods, and wipe out their name from that place.
en.R: Tear down their altars. Smash their stone pillars. Burn the poles used to worship the goddess Asherah. Cut down the statues of their gods. Wipe out the names of those gods from every such place.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:derribarán|derribaréis}} sus altares y {{plural_you:quebrarán|quebraréis}} sus estelas, y sus postes de Aserá {{plural_you:quemarán|quemaréis}} en el fuego, y las imágenes talladas de sus dioses {{plural_you:cortarán|cortaréis}}, y {{plural_you:destruirán|destruiréis}} su nombre de aquel lugar.
es.B: {{plural_you:Derriben|Derribad}} sus altares, {{plural_you:hagan|haced}} pedazos sus piedras sagradas, {{plural_you:quemen|quemad}} sus postes de Aserá, {{plural_you:echen abajo|echad abajo}} las imágenes talladas de sus dioses y {{plural_you:borren|borrad}} su nombre de aquel lugar.
es.R: {{plural_you:Derriben|Derribad}} sus altares. {{plural_you:Rompan|Romped}} sus piedras sagradas. {{plural_you:Quemen|Quemad}} los postes que usan para adorar a la diosa Aserá. {{plural_you:Destrocen|Destrozad}} las estatuas de sus dioses. {{plural_you:Borren|Borrad}} de cada uno de esos lugares los nombres de esos dioses.

fr.L: Et vous démolirez leurs autels et vous briserez leurs stèles, et leurs poteaux d’Ashéra, vous les brûlerez au feu, et les images taillées de leurs dieux, vous les abattrez, et vous ferez disparaître leur nom de ce lieu-là.
fr.B: Démolissez leurs autels, mettez en pièces leurs pierres dressées, brûlez leurs poteaux d’Ashéra, abattez les idoles sculptées de leurs dieux et effacez leur nom de ce lieu.
fr.R: Démolissez leurs autels. Cassez leurs pierres sacrées. Brûlez les poteaux qu’ils utilisent pour adorer la déesse Ashéra. Abattez les statues de leurs dieux. Effacez les noms de ces dieux de chacun de ces lieux.

sw.L: Nanyi mtazibomoa madhabahu zao, na kuzivunja nguzo zao, na miti yao ya Ashera mtaiteketeza kwa moto, na sanamu za kuchonga za miungu yao mtazikata, na mtaliangamiza jina lao kutoka mahali hapo.
sw.B: Bomoeni madhabahu zao, vunjeni vipande vipande nguzo zao za mawe, iteketezeni kwa moto miti yao ya Ashera, kateni sanamu za kuchonga za miungu yao, na lifuteni jina lao mahali hapo.
sw.R: Bomoeni madhabahu zao. Vunjeni nguzo zao za mawe. Chomeni nguzo za miti wanazotumia kumwabudu mungu wa kike Ashera. Kateni sanamu za miungu yao. Futeni majina ya miungu hiyo kutoka kila mahali pa namna hiyo.

vi.L: Các ngươi phải phá đổ các bàn thờ của chúng, đập vỡ các trụ đá thờ của chúng, lấy lửa đốt các trụ A-sê-ra của chúng, đốn ngã các tượng chạm của các thần chúng, và xóa tên chúng khỏi nơi ấy.
vi.B: Hãy phá đổ các bàn thờ, đập vỡ các trụ đá thờ, đốt các trụ A-sê-ra, đốn ngã các tượng thần chạm trổ của chúng, và xóa bỏ tên các thần ấy khỏi nơi đó.
vi.R: Hãy phá đổ các bàn thờ của chúng. Hãy đập vỡ các cột đá thờ của chúng. Hãy đốt những cây cột dùng để thờ nữ thần A-sê-ra. Hãy đốn ngã tượng các thần của chúng. Hãy xóa bỏ tên các thần ấy khỏi mọi nơi như thế.

ko.L: 그리고 너희는 그들의 제단들을 허물고, 그들의 돌기둥들을 깨뜨리고, 그들의 아세라 목상들을 불에 태우고, 그들의 신들의 새긴 우상들을 찍어 버리고, 그곳에서 그들의 이름을 없애 버려라.
ko.B: 그들의 제단을 허물고, 그들이 세운 돌기둥을 깨뜨리고, 아세라 목상을 불태우고, 그들의 신들을 새긴 우상을 찍어 버리고, 그곳에서 그들의 이름을 지워 버려라.
ko.R: 그들의 제단을 허무십시오. 그들이 섬기려고 세운 돌기둥을 부수십시오. 아세라 여신을 섬기려고 세운 나무 기둥을 불태우십시오. 그들의 신상을 찍어 버리십시오. 그런 곳에서 그 신들의 이름을 다 없애 버리십시오.

pt.L: E derrubarão os altares deles, e quebrarão as suas colunas, e os seus postes de Aserá queimarão no fogo, e as imagens esculpidas dos seus deuses cortarão, e destruirão o nome deles daquele lugar.
pt.B: Derrubem os altares deles, despedacem as suas colunas sagradas, queimem os seus postes de Aserá, cortem as imagens esculpidas dos seus deuses e apaguem o nome deles daquele lugar.
pt.R: Derrubem os altares deles. Quebrem as colunas de pedra que eles usam no culto. Queimem os postes de madeira que usam para adorar a deusa Aserá. Cortem as estátuas dos seus deuses. Apaguem os nomes desses deuses de todos esses lugares.

am.L: መሠዊያዎቻቸውንም ታፈርሳላችሁ፤ ሐውልቶቻቸውንም ትሰባብራላችሁ፤ አሼራዎቻቸውንም በእሳት ታቃጥላላችሁ፤ የአማልክታቸውንም የተቀረጹ ምስሎች ትቆርጣላችሁ፤ ስማቸውንም ከዚያ ስፍራ ታጠፋላችሁ።
am.B: መሠዊያዎቻቸውን አፍርሱ፤ የማምለኪያ ሐውልቶቻቸውን ሰባብሩ፤ የአሼራ ማምለኪያ እንጨቶቻቸውን በእሳት አቃጥሉ፤ የአማልክታቸውን የተቀረጹ ምስሎች ቆራርጡ፤ ስማቸውንም ከዚያ ስፍራ ደምስሱ።
am.R: መሠዊያዎቻቸውን አፍርሱ። ለአምልኮ ያቆሟቸውን የድንጋይ ሐውልቶች ሰባብሩ። አሼራ የምትባለውን ሴት አምላክ ለማምለክ የሚጠቀሙባቸውን የእንጨት ዘንጎች አቃጥሉ። የአማልክታቸውን ምስሎች ቆራርጡ። የእነዚያን አማልክት ስም ከእንደዚህ ዓይነቱ ስፍራ ሁሉ ደምስሱ።

hi.L: और तुम उनकी वेदियों को ढा देना और उनके स्तंभों को तोड़ डालना, और उनके अशेरा-स्तंभों को आग में जला देना, और उनके देवताओं की खुदी हुई मूर्तियों को काट डालना, और उस स्थान से उनका नाम मिटा देना।
hi.B: उनकी वेदियों को ढा दो, उनके पूजा के पत्थरों को तोड़ डालो, उनके अशेरा-स्तंभों को जला दो, उनके देवताओं की खुदी हुई मूर्तियों को काट डालो, और उस स्थान से उनका नाम मिटा दो।
hi.R: उनकी वेदियों को ढा दो। उनके पत्थर के स्तंभों को तोड़ डालो। अशेरा देवी की पूजा के खंभों को जला दो। उनके देवताओं की मूर्तियों को काट डालो। ऐसी हर जगह से उन देवताओं का नाम मिटा दो।

ru.L: И разрушьте их жертвенники, и сокрушите их священные столбы, и их столбы Ашеры сожгите огнём, и изваяния их богов срубите, и истребите их имя с того места.
ru.B: Разрушьте их жертвенники, разбейте их священные столбы, сожгите их столбы Ашеры, срубите изваяния их богов и сотрите их имя с того места.
ru.R: Разрушьте их жертвенники. Разбейте их каменные столбы. Сожгите деревянные столбы, которые ставят для поклонения богине Ашере. Срубите статуи их богов. Сотрите имена этих богов со всех таких мест.

ja.L: そしてあなたがたは、彼らの祭壇を打ち倒し、彼らの柱を打ち砕き、彼らのアシェラ像を火で焼き、彼らの神々の彫像を切り倒し、その場所から彼らの名を消し去らなければならない。
ja.B: 彼らの祭壇を打ち倒し、石の柱を打ち砕き、アシェラ像を焼き払い、彼らの神々の刻んだ像を切り倒し、その名をその場所から消し去りなさい。
ja.R: 彼らの祭壇を打ちこわしなさい。石の柱を打ち砕きなさい。女神アシェラを拝むために立てた木の柱を焼きなさい。彼らの神々の偶像を切り倒しなさい。そういう場所から、それらの神々の名を消し去りなさい。

uk.L: І зруйнуйте їхні жертовники, і розтрощіть їхні стовпи, і їхні Ашери спаліть вогнем, і різьблених ідолів їхніх богів порубайте, і знищіть їхнє імʼя з того місця.
uk.B: Зруйнуйте їхні жертовники, розтрощіть їхні священні камені, спаліть їхні Ашери, порубайте різьблених ідолів їхніх богів і зітріть їхнє імʼя з того місця.
uk.R: Зруйнуйте їхні жертовники. Розбийте їхні камʼяні стовпи. Спаліть ашерівські стовпи, якими вони вшановують богиню Ашеру. Порубайте статуї їхніх богів. Зітріть імена тих богів з кожного такого місця.

id.L: Dan robohkanlah mezbah-mezbah mereka, dan hancurkanlah tugu-tugu berhala mereka, dan bakarlah tiang-tiang Asyera mereka dengan api, dan tebanglah patung-patung pahatan allah-allah mereka, dan lenyapkanlah nama mereka dari tempat itu.
id.B: Robohkanlah mezbah-mezbah mereka, hancurkanlah tugu-tugu berhala mereka, bakarlah tiang-tiang Asyera mereka, tebanglah patung-patung allah-allah mereka, dan lenyapkanlah nama mereka dari tempat itu.
id.R: Robohkanlah mezbah-mezbah mereka. Hancurkanlah tugu-tugu batu mereka. Bakarlah tiang-tiang yang dipakai untuk menyembah dewi Asyera. Tebanglah patung-patung allah mereka. Hapuskanlah nama allah-allah itu dari setiap tempat seperti itu.

zh.L: 你们要拆毁他们的祭坛，打碎他们的柱子，用火焚烧他们的亚舍拉木柱，砍下他们神明的雕像，并且从那地方除灭他们的名。
zh.B: 要拆毁他们的祭坛，砸碎他们的立石，烧掉他们的亚舍拉木柱，砍倒他们神明的雕像，从那地方除掉它们的名。
zh.R: 要拆毁他们的祭坛，打碎他们敬拜用的石柱，烧掉他们用来敬拜亚舍拉女神的木柱，砍倒他们神明的像。要从所有这样的地方除掉那些神明的名字。

tl.L: At gigibain ninyo ang kanilang mga altar at dudurugin ang kanilang mga haliging bato, at ang kanilang mga poste ni Ashera ay susunugin ninyo sa apoy, at ang mga inukit na larawan ng kanilang mga diyos ay ibubuwal ninyo, at lilipulin ninyo ang kanilang pangalan mula sa lugar na iyon.
tl.B: Gibain ninyo ang kanilang mga altar, durugin ang kanilang mga sagradong haligi, sunugin ang kanilang mga poste ni Ashera, ibuwal ang mga inukit na larawan ng kanilang mga diyos, at burahin ang kanilang pangalan sa lugar na iyon.
tl.R: Gibain ninyo ang kanilang mga altar. Durugin ninyo ang kanilang mga haliging bato. Sunugin ninyo ang mga posteng ginagamit sa pagsamba sa diyosang si Ashera. Ibuwal ninyo ang mga rebulto ng kanilang mga diyos. Burahin ninyo ang mga pangalan ng mga diyos na iyon sa bawat ganoong lugar.

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਜਗਵੇਦੀਆਂ ਢਾਹ ਦੇਣੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਥੰਮ੍ਹ ਭੰਨ ਦੇਣੇ, ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਅਸ਼ੇਰਾਹ ਥੰਮ੍ਹ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਅੱਗ ਨਾਲ ਸਾੜ ਦੇਣੇ, ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਦੇਵਤਿਆਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਘੜੀਆਂ ਹੋਈਆਂ ਮੂਰਤਾਂ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਵੱਢ ਸੁੱਟਣੀਆਂ, ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਥਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਮਿਟਾ ਦੇਣਾ।
pa.B: ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਜਗਵੇਦੀਆਂ ਢਾਹ ਦਿਓ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਪੂਜਾ ਵਾਲੇ ਪੱਥਰ ਚਕਨਾਚੂਰ ਕਰ ਦਿਓ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਅਸ਼ੇਰਾਹ ਥੰਮ੍ਹ ਸਾੜ ਦਿਓ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਦੇਵਤਿਆਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਘੜੀਆਂ ਮੂਰਤੀਆਂ ਕੱਟ ਸੁੱਟੋ, ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਥਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਤੱਕ ਮਿਟਾ ਦਿਓ।
pa.R: ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਜਗਵੇਦੀਆਂ ਢਾਹ ਦਿਓ। ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਪੂਜਾ ਵਾਲੇ ਪੱਥਰ ਤੋੜ ਦਿਓ। ਅਸ਼ੇਰਾਹ ਦੇਵੀ ਦੀ ਪੂਜਾ ਦੇ ਲੱਕੜ ਦੇ ਥੰਮ੍ਹ ਸਾੜ ਦਿਓ। ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਦੇਵਤਿਆਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਮੂਰਤੀਆਂ ਭੰਨ ਦਿਓ। ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਥਾਵਾਂ ਉੱਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਵੀ ਨਾ ਰਹਿਣ ਦਿਓ।

decisions.choice: altars, pillars, Asherah poles: the same command as 7:5
decisions.reason: The list repeats 7:5 and Exodus 34:13 almost word for word, and adds the carved images. Here it serves a new point: these places must go so that Israel will worship only at the place God chooses (verses 4-5).

decisions.choice: pillars: standing stones set up as sacred objects
decisions.reason: A standing stone marked a holy place or stood for a god. Israel was forbidden to set them up (16:22; Leviticus 26:1), though earlier Jacob had set one up as a memorial (Genesis 28:18).

decisions.choice: Asherah poles: wooden poles or trees for the goddess Asherah
decisions.reason: Asherah was a Canaanite goddess. Her symbol was a wooden pole or a tree planted beside an altar (16:21), which is why it is burned and cut down.

decisions.choice: destroy their name: remove every trace of the gods' worship
decisions.reason: "Their name" is the name of the nations' gods. Calling on a god's name was the heart of worship there; destroying the name means that no one will call on those gods at that place again. Verse 5 sets against this the place where the LORD puts his own name.

decisions.choice: the poles used to worship the goddess Asherah; the names of those gods
decisions.reason: Readable explains Asherah, as settled for these books, and says whose name is meant.

decisions.choice: colunas (L), colunas sagradas (B), colunas de pedra ... no culto (R); postes de Aserá; imagens esculpidas (L, B), estátuas (R)
decisions.reason: The wording of 7:5 and Exodus 34:13 in Portuguese, level by level (m1-m3).

decisions.choice: "ሐውልቶች" and "አሼራዎች" (L); "የማምለኪያ ሐውልቶች" and "የአሼራ ማምለኪያ እንጨቶች" (B); a description at R
decisions.reason: The same command and wording as Exodus 34:13 in Amharic.

decisions.choice: "पूजा के पत्थर" (B); "अशेरा-स्तंभ", "अशेरा देवी की पूजा के खंभे" (R)
decisions.reason: The pillars are standing stones set up as sacred objects (m2), and the Asherah poles are wooden poles or trees for the goddess Asherah (m3). Balanced keeps the words of Exodus 34:13; Readable says what the poles were for, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "священные столбы" (L, B), "каменные столбы" (R); "столбы Ашеры"
decisions.reason: As in 7:5, and Exodus 23:24 and 34:13 in this translation: matsevah is a standing stone set up for worship, and the asherah a wooden pole for the goddess Asherah. The Synodal "рощи" (groves) misleads.

decisions.choice: matsevot "柱" (Literal), "石の柱" (Balanced, Readable); Asherah poles "アシェラ像" (Literal, Balanced), "女神アシェラを拝むために立てた木の柱" (Readable); pesilim "彫像" (Literal), "刻んだ像" (Balanced), "偶像" (Readable), as DEU 7:5
decisions.reason: The forms DEU 7:5 settled for the same list.

decisions.choice: "柱子" (L), "立石" (B), "敬拜用的石柱" (R); "亚舍拉木柱" (L, B), "用来敬拜亚舍拉女神的木柱" (R)
decisions.reason: As Exodus 34:13 and the glossary: Readable explains the standing stones and the Asherah poles (m2, m3).

decisions.choice: "mga altar ... mga haliging bato ... mga poste ni Ashera"
decisions.reason: The same command as 7:5 (m1).

decisions.choice: "mga haliging bato" (L, R); "mga sagradong haligi" (B)
decisions.reason: Standing stones set up as sacred objects (m2).

decisions.choice: "mga poste ni Ashera"; "mga posteng ginagamit sa pagsamba sa diyosang si Ashera" (R)
decisions.reason: Wooden poles or trees for the goddess Asherah (m3), as English (en1).

decisions.choice: "lilipulin ninyo ang kanilang pangalan" (L); "burahin" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Remove every trace of the gods' worship (m4), as English (en1).

source.text: לֹֽא־תַעֲשׂ֣וּן כֵּ֔ן לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Not you shall do so to Yahweh your God.

en.L: You shall not do so to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.
en.B: You must not worship {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God in that way.
en.R: Do not worship {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God the way they worship their gods.

es.L: No {{plural_you:harán|haréis}} así con {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}.
es.B: No {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} adorar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} de esa manera.
es.R: No {{plural_you:adoren|adoréis}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} como ellos adoran a sus dioses.

fr.L: Vous ne ferez pas ainsi pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu.
fr.B: Vous ne devez pas adorer {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu de cette manière.
fr.R: N’adorez pas {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu comme ils adorent leurs dieux.

sw.L: Msimtendee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu hivyo.
sw.B: Msimwabudu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu kwa namna hiyo.
sw.R: Msimwabudu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu jinsi wao wanavyoiabudu miungu yao.

vi.L: Các ngươi không được làm như vậy đối với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi.
vi.B: Anh em không được thờ phượng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em theo cách ấy.
vi.R: Đừng thờ phượng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em theo cách chúng thờ các thần của chúng.

ko.L: 너희는 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 그와 같이 하지 말아라.
ko.B: 너희는 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 그런 식으로 섬겨서는 안 된다.
ko.R: 여러분의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 그들이 자기 신들을 섬기는 방식으로 섬기지 마십시오.

pt.L: Não farão assim {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o Deus de vocês.
pt.B: Não adorem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, dessa maneira.
pt.R: Não adorem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, do jeito que eles adoram os deuses deles.

am.L: ለአምላካችሁ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} እንዲህ አታድርጉ።
am.B: አምላካችሁን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} በዚያ መንገድ አታምልኩ።
am.R: እነርሱ አማልክታቸውን በሚያመልኩበት መንገድ አምላካችሁን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} አታምልኩ።

hi.L: तुम {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर के साथ ऐसा न करना।
hi.B: तुम {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर की आराधना उस रीति से न करना।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर की आराधना उस तरह न करना जैसे वे अपने देवताओं की पूजा करते हैं।

ru.L: Не делайте так {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, вашему Богу.
ru.B: Не поклоняйтесь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, вашему Богу, таким образом.
ru.R: Не поклоняйтесь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, вашему Богу, так, как они поклоняются своим богам.

ja.L: あなたがたは、あなたがたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に対して、そのようにしてはならない。
ja.B: あなたがたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を、そのようなやり方で礼拝してはならない。
ja.R: あなたたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を、彼らが自分たちの神々を拝むようなやり方で礼拝してはいけない。

uk.L: Не робіть так {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, вашому Богові.
uk.B: Не поклоняйтеся так {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, вашому Богові.
uk.R: Не поклоняйтеся {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, вашому Богові, так, як вони поклоняються своїм богам.

id.L: Janganlah kalian berbuat demikian kepada {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah kalian.
id.B: Janganlah kalian beribadah kepada {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah kalian, dengan cara seperti itu.
id.R: Jangan menyembah {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah kalian, dengan cara mereka menyembah allah-allah mereka.

zh.L: 你们不可这样对待{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你们的{{god_term:神|上帝}}。
zh.B: 你们不可用那种方式敬拜{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你们的{{god_term:神|上帝}}。
zh.R: 不要像他们敬拜他们的神明那样，来敬拜{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你们的{{god_term:神|上帝}}。

tl.L: Hindi ninyo gagawin ang gayon {{divine_name:sa PANGINOONG|kay Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos.
tl.B: Huwag ninyong sambahin {{divine_name:ang PANGINOONG|si Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos sa ganoong paraan.
tl.R: Huwag ninyong sambahin {{divine_name:ang PANGINOONG|si Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos sa paraan ng pagsamba nila sa kanilang mga diyos.

pa.L: ਤੁਸੀਂ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਆਪਣੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਨਾਲ ਇਉਂ ਨਾ ਕਰਨਾ।
pa.B: {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਆਪਣੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਦੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਉਸ ਢੰਗ ਨਾਲ ਨਾ ਕਰੋ।
pa.R: {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਆਪਣੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਦੀ ਪੂਜਾ ਉਸ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਨਾ ਕਰੋ ਜਿਵੇਂ ਉਹ ਕੌਮਾਂ ਕਰਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ।

decisions.choice: do so: worship the LORD as the nations worshiped their gods, at many places of your own choosing
alternatives: do not destroy the LORD's altars or name as you destroy theirs
decisions.reason: "So" points back to verse 2: the nations worshiped wherever they chose, on any hill or under any tree. Verse 5 gives the contrast: Israel is to come to the one place God chooses. Another reading takes "so" with verse 3: do not destroy what bears the LORD's name as you destroy theirs. The flow into verse 5 favors the first.

decisions.choice: worship ... in that way
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "do so" means here: the way of worship just described. Literal keeps "do so".

decisions.choice: "Hindi ninyo gagawin ang gayon" (L); "sa ganoong paraan" (B); "sa paraan ng pagsamba nila" (R)
decisions.reason: Worship the LORD as the nations worshiped, at many places of your own choosing (m1), as English (en1).

source.text: כִּ֠י אִֽם־אֶל־הַמָּק֞וֹם אֲשֶׁר־יִבְחַ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֙ מִכָּל־שִׁבְטֵיכֶ֔ם לָשׂ֥וּם אֶת־שְׁמ֖וֹ שָׁ֑ם לְשִׁכְנ֥וֹ תִדְרְשׁ֖וּ וּבָ֥אתָ שָֽׁמָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: But rather to the place which will choose Yahweh your God from all your tribes to put his name there, for his dwelling you shall seek, and you will come there.

en.L: But the place that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God will choose out of all your tribes to put {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name there, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} dwelling, you shall seek, and there you shall come.
en.B: Instead, you must seek the place that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God will choose out of all your tribes to put {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name there as {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} dwelling, and go there.
en.R: Instead, go to the one place that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God will choose from among all your tribes. He will put {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name there and make it {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} home. Go there to worship {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Sino que el lugar que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} escoja de entre todas {{plural_you:sus tribus|vuestras tribus}} para poner allí {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre, {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} morada, {{plural_you:buscarán|buscaréis}}, y allí irás.
es.B: Al contrario, {{plural_you:buscarán|buscaréis}} el lugar que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} escoja de entre todas {{plural_you:sus tribus|vuestras tribus}} para poner allí {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre como {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} morada, y allí irás.
es.R: Al contrario, {{plural_you:vayan|id}} al único lugar que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} escoja de entre todas {{plural_you:sus tribus|vuestras tribus}}. Allí pondrá {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre y hará de ese lugar {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} hogar. Ve allí a adorarlo.

fr.L: Mais le lieu que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu choisira parmi toutes vos tribus pour y mettre {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom, {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} demeure, vous le rechercherez, et là tu viendras.
fr.B: Au contraire, vous rechercherez le lieu que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu choisira parmi toutes vos tribus pour y mettre {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom et en faire {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} demeure, et c’est là que tu iras.
fr.R: Au contraire, allez à l’unique lieu que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu choisira parmi toutes vos tribus. Il y mettra {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom et en fera {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} maison. Va là-bas pour {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}adorer.

sw.L: Bali mahali atakapopachagua {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu kutoka katika makabila yenu yote ili kuweka jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} huko, makao {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, mtapatafuta, nawe utakwenda huko.
sw.B: Badala yake, mtapatafuta mahali ambapo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu atapachagua kutoka katika makabila yenu yote ili aweke jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} huko kama makao {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, nawe utakwenda huko.
sw.R: Badala yake, nendeni mahali pamoja tu ambapo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu atapachagua kutoka katika makabila yenu yote. Ataweka jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} huko na kupafanya kuwa makao {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Nenda huko ukamwabudu.

vi.L: Nhưng nơi mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi sẽ chọn giữa tất cả các chi tộc các ngươi để đặt danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở đó, nơi ngự của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, các ngươi phải tìm đến, và ngươi phải đến đó.
vi.B: Trái lại, anh em phải tìm đến nơi mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em sẽ chọn giữa tất cả các chi tộc anh em để đặt danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở đó làm nơi ngự của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và anh em phải đến đó.
vi.R: Thay vào đó, hãy đến một nơi duy nhất mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em sẽ chọn giữa tất cả các chi tộc anh em. Ngài sẽ đặt danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở đó và lấy nơi ấy làm nhà của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Hãy đến đó để thờ phượng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 오히려 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희의 모든 지파 가운데서 그분의 이름을 두시려고 택하실 곳, 곧 그분의 거처를 너희는 찾고, 그곳으로 가거라.
ko.B: 오히려 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희의 모든 지파 가운데서 그분의 이름을 두어 거처로 삼으시려고 택하실 곳을 찾아 그곳으로 가거라.
ko.R: 오히려 여러분의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 여러분의 모든 지파 가운데서 택하실 그 한 곳으로 가십시오. 그분께서는 그곳에 그분의 이름을 두시고 그곳을 그분의 집으로 삼으실 것입니다. 그곳으로 가서 그분을 섬기십시오.

pt.L: Mas o lugar que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, escolher dentre todas as tribos de vocês para pôr ali o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome, a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} habitação, vocês buscarão, e para lá irás.
pt.B: Em vez disso, busquem o lugar que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, escolher dentre todas as tribos de vocês para pôr ali o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome como {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} habitação, e vão até lá.
pt.R: Em vez disso, vão ao único lugar que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, escolher dentre todas as tribos de vocês. Ele vai pôr ali o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome e fazer dali a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} morada. Vão lá para adorá-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}.

am.L: ነገር ግን አምላካችሁ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ስሙን በዚያ ያኖር ዘንድ ከነገዶቻችሁ ሁሉ የሚመርጠውን ስፍራ፣ ማደሪያውን፣ ትፈልጋላችሁ፤ ወደዚያም ትመጣለህ።
am.B: ይልቁንም አምላካችሁ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ስሙን በዚያ ለማኖርና ማደሪያው ለማድረግ ከነገዶቻችሁ ሁሉ የሚመርጠውን ስፍራ ፈልጉ፤ ወደዚያም ሂዱ።
am.R: ይልቁንም አምላካችሁ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከነገዶቻችሁ ሁሉ መካከል ወደሚመርጠው ወደ አንዱ ስፍራ ሂዱ። ስሙን በዚያ ያኖራል፤ መኖሪያውም ያደርገዋል። እርሱን ለማምለክ ወደዚያ ሂዱ።

hi.L: परंतु जिस स्थान को {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर तुम्हारे सब गोत्रों में से अपना नाम वहाँ रखने के लिए चुनेंगे, उनके निवास को, तुम ढूँढ़ना, और वहीं तुम आना।
hi.B: इसके बजाय तुम उस स्थान को ढूँढ़ना जिसे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर तुम्हारे सब गोत्रों में से चुनेंगे, कि वहाँ अपना नाम रखकर उसे अपना निवास बनाएँ, और वहीं जाना।
hi.R: इसके बजाय उस एक जगह पर जाना जिसे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर तुम्हारे सब गोत्रों में से चुनेंगे। वे वहाँ अपना नाम रखेंगे और उसे अपना घर बनाएँगे। उनकी आराधना करने के लिए वहीं जाना।

ru.L: Но место, которое изберёт {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, ваш Бог, из всех ваших колен, чтобы положить там своё имя, {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} жилище, ищите, и туда приходи.
ru.B: Напротив, ищите место, которое {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, ваш Бог, изберёт из всех ваших колен, чтобы положить там своё имя как своё жилище, и приходи туда.
ru.R: Наоборот, идите к тому единственному месту, которое {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, ваш Бог, выберет среди всех ваших племён. Он положит там своё имя и сделает это место своим домом. Приходите туда поклоняться {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}.

ja.L: むしろ、あなたがたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が、ご自分の名をそこに置くために、あなたがたのすべての部族の中から選ばれる場所、その住まいを、あなたがたは尋ね求め、あなたはそこに行かなければならない。
ja.B: むしろ、あなたがたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が、ご自分の名を置いて住まいとするために、あなたがたの全部族の中から選ばれる場所を尋ね求め、そこに行きなさい。
ja.R: そうではなく、あなたたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が、あなたたちのすべての部族の中から選ばれるただ一つの場所に行きなさい。神はそこにご自分の名を置き、そこをご自分の住まいとされる。そこに行って、神を礼拝しなさい。

uk.L: А місця, яке {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, ваш Бог, вибере з усіх ваших племен, щоб покласти там своє імʼя, {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} оселі шукайте, і туди ти прийдеш.
uk.B: Натомість шукайте місця, яке {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, ваш Бог, вибере з-поміж усіх ваших племен, щоб покласти там своє імʼя як свою оселю, і туди ходи.
uk.R: Натомість ходіть до того єдиного місця, яке {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, ваш Бог, вибере серед усіх ваших племен. Він покладе там своє імʼя і зробить його своєю домівкою. Ходи туди, щоб поклонятися {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}.

id.L: Tetapi tempat yang akan dipilih {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah kalian, dari antara segala suku kalian untuk menaruh nama-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}} di sana, tempat kediaman-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}, haruslah kalian cari, dan ke sanalah engkau harus pergi.
id.B: Sebaliknya, carilah tempat yang akan dipilih {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah kalian, dari antara segala suku kalian untuk menaruh nama-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}} di sana sebagai tempat kediaman-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}, dan pergilah ke sana.
id.R: Sebaliknya, pergilah ke satu tempat yang akan dipilih {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah kalian, dari antara semua suku kalian. Dia akan menaruh nama-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}} di sana dan menjadikannya tempat kediaman-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}. Pergilah ke sana untuk menyembah {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}}.

zh.L: 但{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你们的{{god_term:神|上帝}}要从你们各支派中所选择、在那里立{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}名的地方，就是{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}的居所，你们要寻求，你要到那里去。
zh.B: 你们反倒要寻求{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你们的{{god_term:神|上帝}}从你们各支派中选择、立{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}名作{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}居所的地方，往那里去。
zh.R: 你们反而要到{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你们的{{god_term:神|上帝}}从你们各支派中选择的那一个地方去。{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}要在那里立{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}的名，使那地方成为{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}的家。要到那里去敬拜{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}。

tl.L: Kundi ang lugar na pipiliin {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos mula sa lahat ng inyong mga lipi upang ilagay roon ang {{deity_pronoun:kaniyang|Kaniyang}} pangalan, ang {{deity_pronoun:kaniyang|Kaniyang}} tahanan, ay hahanapin ninyo, at doon ka paroroon.
tl.B: Sa halip, hanapin ninyo ang lugar na pipiliin {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos mula sa lahat ng inyong mga lipi upang ilagay roon ang {{deity_pronoun:kaniyang|Kaniyang}} pangalan bilang {{deity_pronoun:kaniyang|Kaniyang}} tahanan, at pumunta kayo roon.
tl.R: Sa halip, pumunta kayo sa iisang lugar na pipiliin {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos mula sa lahat ng inyong mga lipi. Ilalagay {{deity_pronoun:niya|Niya}} roon ang {{deity_pronoun:kaniyang|Kaniyang}} pangalan at gagawin itong {{deity_pronoun:kaniyang|Kaniyang}} tahanan. Pumunta kayo roon upang sambahin {{deity_pronoun:siya|Siya}}.

pa.L: ਪਰ ਜਿਸ ਥਾਂ ਨੂੰ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਗੋਤਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਚੁਣਨਗੇ ਕਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਮ ਉੱਥੇ ਰੱਖਣ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਨੂੰ, ਤੁਸੀਂ ਭਾਲਣਾ, ਅਤੇ ਉੱਥੇ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਈਂ।
pa.B: ਸਗੋਂ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਉਸ ਥਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਲੱਭਣਾ ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਗੋਤਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਚੁਣਨਗੇ ਕਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਮ ਉੱਥੇ ਰੱਖ ਕੇ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਬਣਾਉਣ, ਅਤੇ ਉੱਥੇ ਹੀ ਜਾਣਾ।
pa.R: {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਗੋਤਾਂ ਦੇ ਇਲਾਕੇ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਇੱਕ ਥਾਂ ਚੁਣਨਗੇ ਜਿੱਥੇ ਲੋਕ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਕਰਨ। ਉਹ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਆਪਣਾ ਘਰ ਬਣਾਉਣਗੇ ਅਤੇ ਉੱਥੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਮ ਰੱਖਣਗੇ। ਉਸੇ ਥਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਲੱਭੋ ਅਤੇ ਉੱਥੇ ਜਾਓ।

decisions.choice: the place he will choose: one place of worship, chosen by God and not by Israel
decisions.reason: The phrase returns through chapters 12-26 (verses 11, 14, 18, 21, 26; 14:23; 16:2). The place is not named. Later it was Shiloh for a time (Joshua 18:1; Jeremiah 7:12) and then Jerusalem (1 Kings 8:29; 2 Kings 21:4). Verse 14 says "in one of your tribes".

decisions.choice: to put his name there: to mark the place as his own and as where he meets his people
decisions.reason: God's name stands for God himself as he is known and called on. Putting his name on a place claims it as his and makes it the place where he is present to hear his people, while he is not confined to it (Exodus 20:24; 1 Kings 8:27-29).

decisions.choice: his dwelling: a noun taken with "you shall seek", following the Hebrew accents
alternatives: to put his name there, to make it dwell; you shall seek [it]
decisions.reason: The word can be read as a noun, "his dwelling", or as a verb, "to make it dwell", which would join it to "to put his name there" (as verse 11 says "to make his name dwell there"). The accents end the first clause after "there" and join "his dwelling" to "you shall seek". Either way the place is where God's name lives among his people.

decisions.choice: seek: go there to worship
decisions.reason: To seek a place or a god here means to go to it to worship and to ask for help (verse 30 uses the same verb of asking about the nations' gods). It is not a search for a hidden place: God will make the place known.

decisions.choice: the one place ... Go there to worship him
decisions.reason: Readable adds "one" from verse 14 and says why Israel is to go there, which "seek" implies.

decisions.choice: plural "{{plural_you:buscarán|buscaréis}}", then singular "irás" / "Ve"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew turns from plural to singular "you" for the last verb; the Spanish follows it, as for the rest of Deuteronomy.

decisions.choice: "sa demeure" (lowercase)
decisions.reason: The word here is "his dwelling" in general, not the tabernacle (mishkan), which these books call "la Demeure" with a capital. Lowercase keeps the two apart.

decisions.choice: "nơi mà CHÚA ... sẽ chọn để đặt danh Ngài ở đó"
decisions.reason: The formula of the chosen place, kept the same wherever it returns in chapters 12-16; Readable adds "duy nhất" (one) as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: o lugar que o SENHOR ... escolher para pôr ali o seu nome; a sua habitação (L, B), a sua morada (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book, as 14:23-24 also have it: the place God will choose (m1) keeps one wording per level. The future subjunctive "escolher" leaves the place unnamed, as the Hebrew does. This phrase, "to put his name there" (m2), is "para pôr ali o seu nome" at Literal and Balanced; the other, "to make his name dwell there" (verse 11), is "para fazer habitar ali o seu nome" at Literal, "como habitação para o seu nome" at Balanced and "como morada para o seu nome" at Readable, so that "habitação" and "morada" stay the words for his dwelling at those levels. Literal takes "a sua habitação" with what follows, as the accents do (m3).

decisions.choice: vocês buscarão, e para lá irás
decisions.reason: The Hebrew turns from the plural "you shall seek" to the singular "you shall come"; Literal keeps it. Balanced and Readable stay in the plural of the sentence.

decisions.choice: Literal follows the Hebrew's change between plural "እናንተ" and singular "አንተ" clause by clause ("ትፈልጋላችሁ ... ትመጣለህ"); Balanced and Readable keep one number within a sentence
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy turns between Israel addressed as many and as one; Amharic marks the number on every verb, so Literal can keep each change. Within a single sentence the change jars in Amharic, so Balanced and Readable follow the clause that leads.

decisions.choice: Formula for these chapters: "እግዚአብሔር የሚመርጠው ስፍራ" (the place he will choose); "to put his name there": "ስሙን በዚያ ያኖር ዘንድ" (L), "ስሙን በዚያ ለማኖር" (B, R); "to make his name dwell there": "ስሙን በዚያ ያሳድር ዘንድ" (L), "ስሙ እንዲያድርበት" (B), "ለስሙ መኖሪያ እንዲሆን" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has two verbs, "put" and "make dwell"; Amharic keeps them apart as "ማኖር" and "ማሳደር" ("ማደሪያ", dwelling), so each occurrence in 12:5, 11, 21; 14:23-24; 16:2, 6, 11 reads alike.

decisions.choice: "जिस स्थान को ... चुनेंगे" and "अपना नाम वहाँ रखना"
decisions.reason: The one place of worship, chosen by God and not by Israel (m1), is named with the same words each time it comes in Deuteronomy, so that the repeated formula stays recognisable: "वह स्थान जिसे प्रभु चुनेंगे", "अपना नाम वहाँ रखना" or "बसाना" (m2).

decisions.choice: "место, которое изберёт ГОСПОДЬ ... чтобы положить там своё имя"
decisions.reason: The formula of the one place of worship recurs through chapters 12-26 and is kept in the same words each time: "положить там своё имя" for sum shem (12:5, 12:21, 14:24) and "поселить там своё имя" for shakken shem (12:11, 14:23, 16:2). Readable says "выберет" and "племён", as the note gives "колено" (L, B) and "племя" (R).

decisions.choice: "ご自分の名を置く" for "put his name there"; "住まい" for his dwelling
decisions.reason: "御名" is not used in this book's Japanese; the light respect "ご自分の" carries Moses' respect for God, as other respect forms in his speech do.

decisions.choice: "tempat yang akan dipilih TUHAN ... untuk menaruh nama-Nya di sana"
decisions.reason: The formula of the chosen place recurs through chapters 12 to 26 and is kept in one wording, with "kediaman" for his dwelling.

decisions.choice: "立{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}名" (L, B, R); "居所" (L, B), "家" (R)
decisions.reason: To put his name there marks the place as his own, where he meets his people (m2); "立名" says it in one verb. Literal takes "his dwelling" with "seek", as the English does (m3).

decisions.choice: "ang lugar na pipiliin"; "iisang lugar" (R)
decisions.reason: One place of worship, chosen by God and not by Israel (m1), as English (en1).

decisions.choice: "ilagay roon ang kaniyang pangalan"
decisions.reason: To mark the place as his own and as where he meets his people (m2).

decisions.choice: "ang kaniyang tahanan, ay hahanapin ninyo" (L)
decisions.reason: A noun taken with "you shall seek", following the Hebrew accents (m3).

decisions.choice: "hahanapin"; "upang sambahin siya" (R)
decisions.reason: Go there to worship (m4).

decisions.choice: "ਜਿਸ ਥਾਂ ਨੂੰ ... ਚੁਣਨਗੇ" and "ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਮ ਉੱਥੇ ਰੱਖਣ" (to put his name there)
decisions.reason: The chosen place is where God's name, his claimed presence, dwells; later it is Jerusalem.

source.text: וַהֲבֵאתֶ֣ם שָׁ֗מָּה עֹלֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ וְזִבְחֵיכֶ֔ם וְאֵת֙ מַעְשְׂרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וְאֵ֖ת תְּרוּמַ֣ת יֶדְכֶ֑ם וְנִדְרֵיכֶם֙ וְנִדְבֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וּבְכֹרֹ֥ת בְּקַרְכֶ֖ם וְצֹאנְכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And you shall bring there your burnt offerings and your sacrifices and your tithes and [the] contribution of your hand, and your vows and your freewill offerings and [the] firstborn of your herd and your flock.

en.L: And there you shall bring your burnt offerings and your sacrifices, and your tithes and the contribution of your hand, and your vow offerings and your freewill offerings, and the firstborn of your herd and of your flock.
en.B: Bring there your burnt offerings and your sacrifices, your tithes and the gifts you set apart, your vow offerings and your freewill offerings, and the firstborn of your herds and flocks.
en.R: Bring all your offerings there: your burnt offerings and other sacrifices, the tenth of your crops, your special gifts, the gifts you promised to give, the gifts you choose to give, and the firstborn of your cattle, sheep and goats.

es.L: Y allí {{plural_you:traerán|traeréis}} {{plural_you:sus holocaustos y sus sacrificios|vuestros holocaustos y vuestros sacrificios}}, y {{plural_you:sus diezmos|vuestros diezmos}} y la ofrenda alzada de {{plural_you:su mano|vuestra mano}}, y {{plural_you:sus ofrendas votivas y sus ofrendas voluntarias|vuestras ofrendas votivas y vuestras ofrendas voluntarias}}, y los primogénitos de {{plural_you:su ganado mayor y de su ganado menor|vuestro ganado mayor y de vuestro ganado menor}}.
es.B: {{plural_you:Lleven|Llevad}} allí {{plural_you:sus holocaustos y sus sacrificios, sus diezmos|vuestros holocaustos y vuestros sacrificios, vuestros diezmos}} y las contribuciones que {{plural_you:apartan|apartáis}}, {{plural_you:sus ofrendas votivas y sus ofrendas voluntarias|vuestras ofrendas votivas y vuestras ofrendas voluntarias}}, y los primogénitos de {{plural_you:sus manadas y sus rebaños|vuestras manadas y vuestros rebaños}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Lleven|Llevad}} allí todas {{plural_you:sus ofrendas|vuestras ofrendas}}: los holocaustos y los demás sacrificios, la décima parte de {{plural_you:sus cosechas|vuestras cosechas}}, {{plural_you:sus ofrendas especiales|vuestras ofrendas especiales}}, lo que {{plural_you:prometieron|prometisteis}} dar, lo que {{plural_you:decidan|decidáis}} dar por {{plural_you:su propia voluntad|vuestra propia voluntad}}, y las primeras crías de {{plural_you:sus vacas, ovejas y cabras|vuestras vacas, ovejas y cabras}}.

fr.L: Et vous apporterez là vos holocaustes et vos sacrifices, et vos dîmes et l’offrande élevée de votre main, et vos offrandes votives et vos offrandes volontaires, et les premiers-nés de votre gros bétail et de votre petit bétail.
fr.B: Apportez-y vos holocaustes et vos sacrifices, vos dîmes et les contributions que vous mettez à part, vos offrandes votives et vos offrandes volontaires, ainsi que les premiers-nés de votre gros et de votre petit bétail.
fr.R: Apportez-y toutes vos offrandes : vos holocaustes et vos autres sacrifices, le dixième de vos récoltes, vos dons spéciaux, les dons que vous avez promis de faire, ceux que vous choisissez de faire, et les premiers-nés de vos bœufs, de vos moutons et de vos chèvres.

sw.L: Nanyi mtaleta huko sadaka zenu za kuteketezwa na dhabihu zenu, na mafungu yenu ya kumi na sadaka ya kuinuliwa ya mkono wenu, na sadaka zenu za nadhiri na sadaka zenu za hiari, na wazaliwa wa kwanza wa ng'ombe wenu na wa kondoo wenu.
sw.B: Leteni huko sadaka zenu za kuteketezwa na dhabihu zenu, mafungu yenu ya kumi na michango mnayoitenga, sadaka zenu za nadhiri na sadaka zenu za hiari, pamoja na wazaliwa wa kwanza wa makundi yenu ya ng'ombe na ya kondoo.
sw.R: Leteni huko sadaka zenu zote: sadaka za kuteketezwa na dhabihu nyingine, sehemu ya kumi ya mazao yenu, zawadi zenu maalum, zawadi mlizoahidi kutoa, zawadi mnazoamua kutoa kwa hiari yenu, na wazaliwa wa kwanza wa ng'ombe, kondoo na mbuzi wenu.

vi.L: Các ngươi phải đem đến đó các của lễ thiêu, các sinh tế, các phần mười, của lễ dâng riêng của tay các ngươi, các lễ vật khấn nguyện, các lễ vật tự nguyện, và các con đầu lòng của bầy bò và bầy chiên các ngươi.
vi.B: Hãy đem đến đó các của lễ thiêu và sinh tế, các phần mười và của lễ dâng riêng, các lễ vật khấn nguyện và lễ vật tự nguyện, cùng các con đầu lòng trong bầy bò và bầy chiên dê của anh em.
vi.R: Hãy đem tất cả lễ vật của anh em đến đó: các của lễ thiêu và những sinh tế khác, một phần mười hoa lợi, những lễ vật đặc biệt, những lễ vật anh em đã hứa dâng, những lễ vật anh em tự ý dâng, và các con đầu lòng của bò, chiên và dê.

ko.L: 그리고 너희는 그곳으로 너희의 번제물과 너희의 희생 제물과 너희의 십분의 일과 너희 손으로 들어 바치는 제물과 너희의 서원 제물과 너희의 자원하는 예물과 너희 소 떼와 양 떼의 처음 난 것을 가져가거라.
ko.B: 너희의 번제물과 희생 제물, 십분의 일과 들어 바치는 제물, 서원한 제물과 자원하는 예물, 그리고 소 떼와 양 떼의 처음 난 것을 그곳으로 가져가거라.
ko.R: 여러분의 모든 제물을 그곳으로 가져가십시오. 번제물과 그 밖의 제물, 수확의 십분의 일, 특별한 예물, 바치겠다고 약속한 예물, 스스로 원해서 바치는 예물, 그리고 소와 양과 염소의 첫 새끼를 가져가십시오.

pt.L: E para lá trarão os seus holocaustos e os seus sacrifícios, e os seus dízimos e a oferta alçada da sua mão, e as suas ofertas votivas e as suas ofertas voluntárias, e os primogênitos do seu gado e do seu rebanho.
pt.B: Levem para lá os seus holocaustos e os seus sacrifícios, os seus dízimos e as suas contribuições, as ofertas dos seus votos e as suas ofertas voluntárias, e os primogênitos dos seus rebanhos de gado e de ovelhas.
pt.R: Levem para lá todas as suas ofertas: os holocaustos e os outros sacrifícios, a décima parte das suas colheitas, as suas ofertas especiais, as ofertas que vocês prometeram dar, as ofertas que vocês quiserem dar e as primeiras crias do seu gado, das suas ovelhas e das suas cabras.

am.L: ወደዚያም የሚቃጠሉ መሥዋዕቶቻችሁንና መሥዋዕቶቻችሁን፣ አሥራቶቻችሁንና የእጃችሁን የሚነሣ መባ፣ ስእለቶቻችሁንና የፈቃድ መሥዋዕቶቻችሁን፣ የከብታችሁንና የመንጋችሁን በኩሮች ታመጣላችሁ።
am.B: የሚቃጠሉ መሥዋዕቶቻችሁንና መሥዋዕቶቻችሁን፣ አሥራቶቻችሁንና ለይታችሁ የምታቀርቡትን መባ፣ የስእለት መባዎቻችሁንና የፈቃድ መሥዋዕቶቻችሁን፣ የከብታችሁንና የመንጋችሁን በኩሮች ወደዚያ አምጡ።
am.R: መባዎቻችሁን ሁሉ ወደዚያ አምጡ፤ የሚቃጠሉ መሥዋዕቶቻችሁንና ሌሎች መሥዋዕቶቻችሁን፣ የሰብላችሁን አንድ አሥረኛ፣ ልዩ ስጦታዎቻችሁን፣ ለመስጠት የተሳላችሁትን፣ በፈቃዳችሁ የምትሰጡትን፣ እንዲሁም ከከብቶቻችሁ፣ ከበጎቻችሁና ከፍየሎቻችሁ መጀመሪያ የተወለዱትን።

hi.L: और वहीं तुम अपनी होमबलियाँ और अपने बलिदान, और अपने दशमांश और अपने हाथ की उठाई हुई भेंट, और अपनी मन्नत की भेंटें और अपनी स्वेच्छा की भेंटें, और अपने गाय-बैलों और अपनी भेड़-बकरियों के पहलौठे ले जाना।
hi.B: वहीं अपनी होमबलियाँ और अपने बलिदान, अपने दशमांश और अलग की हुई भेंटें, अपनी मन्नत की भेंटें और स्वेच्छा की भेंटें, और अपने गाय-बैलों और भेड़-बकरियों के पहलौठे ले जाना।
hi.R: अपनी सब भेंटें वहीं ले जाना: अपनी होमबलियाँ और दूसरे बलिदान, अपनी उपज का दसवाँ भाग, अपनी विशेष भेंटें, वे भेंटें जिन्हें देने की तुमने मन्नत मानी हो, वे भेंटें जिन्हें तुम अपनी इच्छा से देना चाहो, और अपने गाय-बैलों और भेड़-बकरियों के पहलौठे।

ru.L: И приносите туда ваши всесожжения, и ваши жертвы, и ваши десятины, и возношение вашей руки, и ваши обетные дары, и ваши добровольные приношения, и первенцев вашего крупного и мелкого скота.
ru.B: Приносите туда свои всесожжения и жертвы, свои десятины и приношения, которые вы отделяете, свои обетные дары и добровольные приношения, а также первенцев своего крупного и мелкого скота.
ru.R: Приносите туда все свои дары: всесожжения и другие жертвы, десятую часть урожая, особые дары, дары, которые вы обещали принести, дары, которые вы приносите по своему желанию, и первенцев своих коров, овец и коз.

ja.L: そしてあなたがたは、そこに、あなたがたの焼き尽くすささげ物と、あなたがたのいけにえと、あなたがたの十分の一と、あなたがたの手の献納物と、あなたがたの誓願のささげ物と、あなたがたの自発のささげ物と、あなたがたの牛と羊の初子を携えて行かなければならない。
ja.B: そこに、焼き尽くすささげ物といけにえ、十分の一と取り分けたささげ物、誓願のささげ物と自発のささげ物、そして牛や羊の初子を携えて行きなさい。
ja.R: ささげ物は、すべてそこに持って行きなさい。焼いてささげるいけにえやほかのいけにえ、作物の十分の一、特別なささげ物、ささげると誓った物、自分から進んでささげる物、そして、牛や羊ややぎの初子を持って行きなさい。

uk.L: І приносьте туди ваші всепалення, і ваші жертви, і ваші десятини, і приношення вашої руки, і ваші обітні жертви, і ваші добровільні жертви, і первістків вашої худоби і вашої отари.
uk.B: Приносьте туди свої всепалення й жертви, свої десятини й дари, які ви відкладаєте для {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, свої обітні й добровільні жертви та первістків своєї худоби й отар.
uk.R: Приносьте туди всі свої дари: всепалення та інші жертви, десяту частину врожаю, особливі дари, дари, які ви пообіцяли дати, дари, які ви даєте з власної волі, і первістків вашої худоби, овець і кіз.

id.L: Dan ke sanalah kalian harus membawa korban-korban bakaran kalian dan korban-korban sembelihan kalian, dan persepuluhan kalian dan persembahan khusus tangan kalian, dan korban-korban nazar kalian dan persembahan-persembahan sukarela kalian, dan anak-anak sulung lembu sapi kalian dan kambing domba kalian.
id.B: Bawalah ke sana korban bakaran dan korban sembelihan kalian, persepuluhan dan persembahan khusus kalian, korban nazar dan persembahan sukarela kalian, serta anak sulung lembu dan domba kalian.
id.R: Bawalah semua persembahan kalian ke sana: korban bakaran dan korban-korban lain, sepersepuluh dari hasil panen kalian, persembahan khusus kalian, persembahan yang kalian janjikan, persembahan yang kalian berikan dengan sukarela, dan anak sulung lembu, domba, dan kambing kalian.

zh.L: 你们要把你们的燔祭、你们的祭物、你们的十分之一、你们手中的举祭、你们的许愿祭、你们甘心献的礼物，以及你们牛群和羊群中头生的，都带到那里。
zh.B: 要把你们的燔祭和祭物、你们的十分之一和分别出来的举祭、你们许愿献的祭和甘心献的礼物，以及你们牛群羊群中头生的，都带到那里。
zh.R: 要把你们所有的祭物带到那里：你们的全烧的祭和其他的祭，你们农作物的十分之一，你们特别献上的礼物，你们许愿要献的礼物，你们自愿献的礼物，还有你们的牛、绵羊和山羊中头生的。

tl.L: At doon ninyo dadalhin ang inyong mga handog na sinusunog at ang inyong mga hain, at ang inyong mga ikasampung bahagi at ang ambag ng inyong kamay, at ang inyong mga handog na panata at ang inyong mga kusang-loob na handog, at ang mga panganay ng inyong mga baka at ng inyong kawan.
tl.B: Dalhin ninyo roon ang inyong mga handog na sinusunog at ang inyong mga hain, ang inyong mga ikasampung bahagi at ang mga ambag na inyong ibinukod, ang inyong mga handog na panata at ang inyong mga kusang-loob na handog, at ang mga panganay ng inyong mga baka at mga kawan.
tl.R: Dalhin ninyo roon ang lahat ng inyong mga handog: ang inyong mga handog na sinusunog at iba pang mga hain, ang ikasampung bahagi ng inyong ani, ang inyong natatanging mga kaloob, ang mga kaloob na ipinangako ninyong ibibigay, ang mga kaloob na kusa ninyong ibinibigay, at ang mga panganay ng inyong mga baka, tupa at kambing.

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਉੱਥੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਆਪਣੀਆਂ ਹੋਮ ਬਲੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਆਪਣੀਆਂ ਬਲੀਆਂ, ਅਤੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਦਸਵੰਧ ਅਤੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਹੱਥ ਦੀ ਚੁੱਕਣ ਦੀ ਭੇਟ, ਅਤੇ ਆਪਣੀਆਂ ਸੁੱਖਣਾ ਦੀਆਂ ਭੇਟਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਆਪਣੀਆਂ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ੀ ਦੀਆਂ ਭੇਟਾਂ, ਅਤੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਵੱਗ ਅਤੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਇੱਜੜ ਦੇ ਪਹਿਲੌਠੇ ਲਿਆਉਣਾ।
pa.B: ਉੱਥੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਣੀਆਂ ਹੋਮ ਬਲੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਹੋਰ ਬਲੀਆਂ, ਆਪਣੇ ਦਸਵੰਧ ਅਤੇ ਅਲੱਗ ਰੱਖੀਆਂ ਭੇਟਾਂ, ਆਪਣੀਆਂ ਸੁੱਖਣਾ ਦੀਆਂ ਭੇਟਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ੀ ਨਾਲ ਦਿੱਤੀਆਂ ਭੇਟਾਂ, ਅਤੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਗਾਂ-ਬਲਦਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਭੇਡਾਂ-ਬੱਕਰੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਪਹਿਲੌਠੇ ਲਿਆਓ।
pa.R: ਉੱਥੇ ਆਪਣੀਆਂ ਹੋਮ ਬਲੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਹੋਰ ਬਲੀਆਂ ਲਿਆਓ। ਆਪਣੀ ਉਪਜ ਦਾ ਦਸਵਾਂ ਹਿੱਸਾ ਅਤੇ ਆਪਣੀਆਂ ਖ਼ਾਸ ਭੇਟਾਂ ਲਿਆਓ। ਜਿਹੜੀਆਂ ਭੇਟਾਂ ਦੇਣ ਦੀ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਸੁੱਖਣਾ ਸੁੱਖੀ ਹੈ, ਅਤੇ ਜਿਹੜੀਆਂ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਆਪਣੀ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ੀ ਨਾਲ ਦੇਣਾ ਚਾਹੁੰਦੇ ਹੋ, ਉਹ ਵੀ ਲਿਆਓ। ਆਪਣੇ ਪਸ਼ੂਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਭੇਡਾਂ-ਬੱਕਰੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਪਹਿਲੌਠੇ ਬੱਚੇ ਵੀ ਉੱਥੇ ਲਿਆਓ।

decisions.choice: burnt offerings and sacrifices: offerings burned whole, and offerings shared in a meal
decisions.reason: A burnt offering was burned entirely on the altar (Leviticus 1). A "sacrifice" here is an animal slaughtered for a meal: part went on the altar and the worshipers ate the rest, like the peace offering (Leviticus 3; 7:11-18). This is why verse 7 says "you shall eat there".

decisions.choice: tithes: a tenth of the year's produce
decisions.reason: A tenth of grain, wine and oil was set apart each year (14:22-29). Deuteronomy has it eaten at the chosen place by the family, with the Levite (verses 17-18).

decisions.choice: the contribution of your hand: a gift taken off and set apart for God
decisions.reason: The word comes from the verb "lift" or "take off": a portion lifted out from what one has and given to the sanctuary (Exodus 25:2; Numbers 18:24). "Of your hand" means what you yourself give.

decisions.choice: vow offerings and freewill offerings: gifts once promised, and gifts given of one's own accord
decisions.reason: A vow offering paid a promise made to God, often when asking his help; a freewill offering was given with no promise or obligation (Leviticus 7:16; 22:18-23).

decisions.choice: the gifts you set apart; the tenth of your crops; the gifts you promised / choose to give
decisions.reason: Balanced says what the "contribution of your hand" is. Readable explains each offering in plain words, and says "cattle, sheep and goats", since a flock was of both.

decisions.choice: "offrandes votives"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "your vows", meaning the offerings that pay them; "offrandes votives" names the gift, as the English "vow offerings" does.

decisions.choice: "sinh tế" (sacrifices), "phần mười" (tithes), "của lễ dâng riêng" (contribution), "lễ vật khấn nguyện" and "lễ vật tự nguyện" (vow and freewill offerings)
decisions.reason: The offering names of Exodus and Leviticus and the term sheet, kept through chapters 12-15; Readable says what each gift is.

decisions.choice: "십분의 일"; "들어 바치는 제물" (R: "특별한 예물"); "서원 제물"; "자원하는 예물"
decisions.reason: The words the Korean of Exodus and Leviticus uses for these gifts, kept for the lists of offerings that recur through Deuteronomy 12-14; "십분의 일" rather than the church word "십일조", as the Genesis sheet chose.

decisions.choice: holocaustos; sacrifícios; dízimos (L, B), a décima parte (R); oferta alçada (L), contribuições (B), ofertas especiais (R); ofertas votivas / ofertas dos seus votos; ofertas voluntárias
decisions.reason: The names of the offerings as Exodus to Numbers set them in Portuguese: "holocausto", "o dízimo" (14:22), the terumah as "oferta alçada", "contribuição" and "oferta especial" by level (Exodus 25:2), "voto" and "oferta voluntária" (Leviticus 7:16). Readable explains each one, as the English does (r-en-1).

decisions.choice: "አሥራት" (L, B), "አንድ አሥረኛ" (R) for tithes; "የሚነሣ መባ" (L), "ለይታችሁ የምታቀርቡት መባ" (B), "ልዩ ስጦታ" (R) for the contribution; "የስእለት መባ", "የፈቃድ መሥዋዕት" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The terms list and the settled choices (tithe "አሥራት", contribution "የሚነሣ መባ" / "መባ" / "ስጦታ", freewill offering "የፈቃድ መሥዋዕት"). Herd and flock are "ከብት" and "መንጋ" (sheep and goats), spelled out at Readable.

decisions.choice: "होमबलि" (burnt offering); "दशमांश" (L, B), "उपज का दसवाँ भाग" (R) for the tithe
decisions.reason: The terms of Leviticus and Numbers for the whole of Deuteronomy: "होमबलि" for the offering burned whole (m1), "दशमांश" for the tenth of the year's produce (m2). Readable says what the tithe is, as the English does. "बलिदान" is the general word for the sacrifices shared in a meal.

decisions.choice: "हाथ की उठाई हुई भेंट" (L), "अलग की हुई भेंटें" (B), "विशेष भेंटें" (R); "मन्नत की भेंटें", "स्वेच्छा की भेंटें"
decisions.reason: The contribution is a gift taken off and set apart for God (m3), called "उठाई हुई भेंट" in Numbers; Balanced says it is set apart. Vow and freewill offerings keep the words of Leviticus.

decisions.choice: "всесожжения", "жертвы", "десятины"
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch note settles "всесожжение" for the burnt offering at every level; this is its first place in Deuteronomy. "Десятина" (L, B) is the living word for the tithe; Readable says what it is, "десятая часть урожая".

decisions.choice: "возношение вашей руки" (L), "приношения, которые вы отделяете" (B), "особые дары" (R); "обетные дары"; "добровольные приношения"
decisions.reason: Terumah is what is lifted off and set apart for God (m3); Literal keeps "возношение", as in Exodus 25:2. A vow offering is a gift once promised, a freewill offering one given of one's own accord (m4).

decisions.choice: terumah of your hand "手の献納物" (Literal), "取り分けたささげ物" (Balanced), "特別なささげ物" (Readable); vow offerings "誓願のささげ物" (Literal, Balanced), "ささげると誓った物" (Readable); freewill offerings "自発のささげ物" (Literal, Balanced), "自分から進んでささげる物" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The offering vocabulary of EXO-LEV, with the Readable forms saying what each gift is.

decisions.choice: "всепалення", "жертви", "десятини", "обітні жертви", "добровільні жертви"
decisions.reason: Offering names follow the Old Testament terms note ("всепалення"); the vow and freewill offerings are named for how they arise, as the English Literal and Balanced name them. Readable spells each one out.

decisions.choice: "korban bakaran"; "korban sembelihan"; "persepuluhan" (L, B), "sepersepuluh dari hasil panen" (R); "persembahan khusus" for the terumah; "korban nazar"; "persembahan sukarela"
decisions.reason: The glossary's words for the offerings, kept through the book; Readable says what each gift is, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "燔祭" (L, B), "全烧的祭" (R); "祭物" (L, B), "其他的祭" (R); "十分之一"; "举祭" (L, B), "特别献上的礼物" (R)
decisions.reason: The glossary's offering words, as Leviticus uses them. The "sacrifices" are the offerings shared in a meal (m1); the tithe is a tenth of the year's produce (m2); the contribution is a gift set apart for God (m3).

decisions.choice: "许愿祭" (L), "许愿献的祭" (B), "许愿要献的礼物" (R); "甘心献的礼物" (L, B), "自愿献的礼物" (R)
decisions.reason: Gifts once promised, and gifts given of one's own accord (m4), with the glossary's words for vow and free-will gift.

decisions.choice: "mga handog na sinusunog ... mga hain"
decisions.reason: Offerings burned whole, and offerings shared in a meal (m1).

decisions.choice: "mga ikasampung bahagi"; "ikasampung bahagi ng inyong ani" (R)
decisions.reason: A tenth of the year's produce (m2), as English (en1).

decisions.choice: "ang ambag ng inyong kamay" (L); "ang mga ambag na inyong ibinukod" (B); "natatanging mga kaloob" (R)
decisions.reason: A gift taken off and set apart for God (m3), as English (en1).

decisions.choice: "mga handog na panata ... mga kusang-loob na handog"; "ipinangako ... kusa" (R)
decisions.reason: Gifts once promised, and gifts given of one's own accord (m4), as English (en1).

decisions.choice: "ਹੋਮ ਬਲੀ" (burnt offering); "ਦਸਵੰਧ" (L, B), "ਉਪਜ ਦਾ ਦਸਵਾਂ ਹਿੱਸਾ" (R) for the tithe
decisions.reason: As in Chronicles and Malachi 3:8-10.

decisions.choice: "ਹੱਥ ਦੀ ਚੁੱਕਣ ਦੀ ਭੇਟ" (L), "ਅਲੱਗ ਰੱਖੀਆਂ ਭੇਟਾਂ" (B), "ਖ਼ਾਸ ਭੇਟਾਂ" (R); "ਸੁੱਖਣਾ ਦੀਆਂ ਭੇਟਾਂ" (vow offerings)
decisions.reason: Terumah is a portion lifted off and set apart for God.

source.text: וַאֲכַלְתֶּם־שָׁ֗ם לִפְנֵי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם וּשְׂמַחְתֶּ֗ם בְּכֹל֙ מִשְׁלַ֣ח יֶדְכֶ֔ם אַתֶּ֖ם וּבָתֵּיכֶ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בֵּֽרַכְךָ֖ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you shall eat there before Yahweh your God, and you shall rejoice in all [the] undertaking of your hand, you and your households, which has blessed you Yahweh your God.

en.L: And you shall eat there before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, and you shall rejoice in all the undertaking of your hand, you and your households, in which {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God has blessed you.
en.B: There you and your households are to eat in the presence of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God and rejoice in all that you have set your hand to, all that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God has blessed you with.
en.R: There, in front of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, you and your families will eat and be glad for everything you have worked for. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} your God has blessed you with it all.
