es.L: Y {{plural_you:comerán|comeréis}} allí delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, y {{plural_you:se alegrarán|os alegraréis}} en toda empresa de {{plural_you:su mano|vuestra mano}}, {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y {{plural_you:sus casas|vuestras casas}}, en lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te ha bendecido.
es.B: Allí {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y {{plural_you:sus familias|vuestras familias}} {{plural_you:comerán|comeréis}} en presencia {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} y {{plural_you:se alegrarán|os alegraréis}} por todo lo que {{plural_you:hayan emprendido|hayáis emprendido}}, por todo aquello con que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te ha bendecido.
es.R: Allí, delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y {{plural_you:sus familias|vuestras familias}} {{plural_you:comerán y se alegrarán|comeréis y os alegraréis}} por todo lo que {{plural_you:han logrado|habéis logrado}} con {{plural_you:su trabajo|vuestro trabajo}}. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te ha bendecido con todo ello.

fr.L: Et vous mangerez là devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu, et vous vous réjouirez de toute l’entreprise de votre main, vous et vos maisons, en quoi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu t’a béni.
fr.B: Là, vous et vos maisonnées, vous mangerez en présence {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} votre Dieu et vous vous réjouirez de tout ce que vous avez entrepris, de tout ce dont {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu t’a béni.
fr.R: Là, devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu, vous et vos familles, vous mangerez et vous vous réjouirez de tout ce que vous avez gagné par votre travail. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu t’a béni en te donnant tout cela.

sw.L: Nanyi mtakula huko mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, na kufurahi katika kila kazi ya mkono wenu, ninyi na nyumba zenu, ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako amekubariki kwayo.
sw.B: Huko ninyi na jamaa zenu mtakula mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, na kufurahia kila kazi mliyoifanya, yote ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako amekubariki nayo.
sw.R: Huko, mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, ninyi na familia zenu mtakula na kufurahia kila kitu mlichopata kwa kazi yenu. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako amekubariki kwa hayo yote.

vi.L: Các ngươi sẽ ăn tại đó trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi, và các ngươi sẽ vui mừng trong mọi việc tay các ngươi làm, các ngươi và gia đình các ngươi, là việc mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi đã ban phước cho ngươi.
vi.B: Tại đó, anh em cùng gia đình mình sẽ ăn trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em và vui mừng về mọi việc tay anh em làm, mọi điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em đã ban phước cho anh em.
vi.R: Tại đó, trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, anh em và gia đình mình sẽ ăn uống và vui mừng về mọi thứ anh em đã làm ra. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em đã ban phước cho anh em có tất cả những thứ ấy.

ko.L: 그리고 너희는 거기서 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 먹고, 너희와 너희 집안이 너희 손으로 하는 모든 일에서 즐거워하여라. 그 일에 네 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너에게 복을 주셨다.
ko.B: 그곳 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 너희와 너희 집안 식구들이 함께 먹고, 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 복을 주셔서 너희가 손으로 이룬 모든 것을 두고 즐거워하여라.
ko.R: 그곳 여러분의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 여러분과 여러분의 가족들이 함께 먹으십시오. 그리고 여러분이 수고하여 얻은 모든 것을 두고 기뻐하십시오. 그 모든 것은 여러분의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 복을 주셔서 얻은 것입니다.

pt.L: E comerão ali diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, e se alegrarão em todo o empreendimento da mão de vocês, vocês e as suas casas, no qual {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, te abençoou.
pt.B: Ali, vocês e as suas famílias comerão na presença {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, e se alegrarão com todo o trabalho das suas mãos, com tudo aquilo com que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} os abençoou.
pt.R: Ali, diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, vocês e as suas famílias vão comer e se alegrar por tudo aquilo por que trabalharam. Foi {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, que abençoou vocês com tudo isso.

am.L: በዚያም በአምላካችሁ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት ትበላላችሁ፤ አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በባረከህ በእጃችሁ ሥራ ሁሉ እናንተና ቤተ ሰቦቻችሁ ደስ ይላችኋል።
am.B: በዚያ እናንተና ቤተሰቦቻችሁ በአምላካችሁ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት ብሉ፤ እጃችሁን በጫናችሁበት ነገር ሁሉ፣ አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በባረከህ በዚያ ሁሉ ደስ ይበላችሁ።
am.R: በዚያ በአምላካችሁ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት እናንተና ቤተሰቦቻችሁ ትበላላችሁ፤ በደከማችሁበትም ነገር ሁሉ ደስ ይላችኋል። አምላካችሁ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ይህን ሁሉ ባርኮላችኋል።

hi.L: और वहाँ तुम {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर के सामने खाना, और अपने हाथ के सब कामों में, जिनमें {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर ने तुम्हें आशीष दी है, तुम और तुम्हारे घराने आनंद करना।
hi.B: वहाँ तुम और तुम्हारे घराने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर के सामने खाएँ, और उन सब कामों में जिनमें तुमने हाथ लगाया है, और जिनमें {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर ने तुम्हें आशीष दी है, आनंद करें।
hi.R: वहाँ {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर के सामने तुम और तुम्हारे परिवार खाना खाएँगे, और उन सब चीज़ों के लिए आनंद करेंगे जिनके लिए तुमने मेहनत की है। {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर ने ही तुम्हें यह सब देकर आशीष दी है।

ru.L: И ешьте там пред {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}}, вашим Богом, и веселитесь во всяком начинании вашей руки, вы и ваши семьи, в чём благословил тебя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог.
ru.B: Там вы и ваши семьи будете есть перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}}, вашим Богом, и радоваться всему, за что вы принимались, всему, чем благословил тебя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог.
ru.R: Там, перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}}, вашим Богом, вы и ваши семьи будете есть и радоваться всему, ради чего вы трудились. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, ваш Бог, благословил вас всем этим.

ja.L: そしてあなたがたは、そこで、あなたがたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の前で食べ、あなたがたとあなたがたの家族は、あなたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}があなたを祝福された、あなたがたの手のすべての業を喜ばなければならない。
ja.B: そこで、あなたがたとその家族は、あなたがたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の前で食べ、手がけたすべてのことを喜びなさい。あなたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が、それを祝福してくださったのである。
ja.R: そこで、あなたたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の前で、あなたたちと家族は食事をし、自分たちが働いて得たすべての物を喜ぶ。あなたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が、そのすべてを祝福してくださったのだ。

uk.L: І їжте там перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}}, вашим Богом, і радійте всім починанням вашої руки, ви і ваші доми, в чому благословив тебе {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог.
uk.B: Там ви й ваші родини маєте їсти перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}}, вашим Богом, і радіти всьому, до чого ви приклали руку, усьому, чим благословив тебе {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог.
uk.R: Там, перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}}, вашим Богом, ви й ваші родини їстимете й радітимете всьому, над чим ви трудилися. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, благословив тебе всім цим.

id.L: Dan di sanalah kalian harus makan di hadapan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah kalian, dan bersukacita atas segala usaha tangan kalian, kalian dan seisi rumah kalian, yang di dalamnya {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allahmu, telah memberkati engkau.
id.B: Di sana kalian dan keluarga kalian harus makan di hadapan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah kalian, dan bersukacita atas segala usaha kalian, segala yang telah diberkati {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allahmu, bagimu.
id.R: Di sana, di hadapan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah kalian, kalian dan keluarga kalian akan makan dan bergembira atas semua hasil kerja kalian. {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah kalian, sudah memberkati kalian dengan semuanya itu.

zh.L: 你们要在那里，在{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你们的{{god_term:神|上帝}}面前吃，你们和你们的家眷要因你们手所做的一切欢喜，那是{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你的{{god_term:神|上帝}}赐福给你的。
zh.B: 你们和你们的家人要在那里，在{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你们的{{god_term:神|上帝}}面前吃，为你们所从事的一切欢喜，那都是{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你的{{god_term:神|上帝}}赐福给你的。
zh.R: 在那里，在{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你们的{{god_term:神|上帝}}面前，你们和你们的家人要一起吃，并且为你们辛苦得来的一切而欢喜。这一切都是{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你的{{god_term:神|上帝}}赐福给你的。

tl.L: At doon kayo kakain sa harap {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos, at magagalak kayo sa lahat ng gawain ng inyong kamay, kayo at ang inyong mga sambahayan, na sa mga iyon ay pinagpala ka {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} iyong Diyos.
tl.B: Doon kayo at ang inyong mga sambahayan ay kakain sa harap {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos, at magagalak sa lahat ng inyong pinagpaguran, sa lahat ng ipinagpala sa inyo {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos.
tl.R: Doon, sa harap {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos, kayo at ang inyong mga pamilya ay kakain at magagalak sa lahat ng inyong pinaghirapan. Pinagpala kayo {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos ng lahat ng iyon.

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਉੱਥੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਆਪਣੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਦੇ ਅੱਗੇ ਖਾਣਾ, ਅਤੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਅਤੇ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਘਰਾਣੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਹੱਥ ਦੇ ਹਰ ਕੰਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਅਨੰਦ ਕਰਨਾ, ਜਿਸ ਵਿੱਚ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਤੇਰੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਨੇ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਬਰਕਤ ਦਿੱਤੀ ਹੈ।
pa.B: ਉੱਥੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਅਤੇ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਪਰਿਵਾਰ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਆਪਣੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਦੀ ਹਜ਼ੂਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਖਾਓ, ਅਤੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਹਰ ਮਿਹਨਤ ਦੇ ਫਲ ਉੱਤੇ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ੀ ਮਨਾਓ, ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਇਹ ਸਭ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਦੀ ਬਰਕਤ ਨਾਲ ਹੋਇਆ ਹੈ।
pa.R: ਉੱਥੇ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਦੇ ਸਾਹਮਣੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਅਤੇ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਪਰਿਵਾਰ ਭੋਜਨ ਖਾਓ। ਤੁਸੀਂ ਜੋ ਕੁਝ ਵੀ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੈ ਉਸ ਲਈ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ੀ ਮਨਾਓ, ਕਿਉਂਕਿ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਨੇ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਉੱਤੇ ਬਰਕਤ ਪਾਈ ਹੈ।

decisions.choice: eat there before the LORD: a joyful meal at the sanctuary
decisions.reason: The worshipers ate their share of the sacrifices, tithes and firstborn at the chosen place, as a feast in God's presence (14:23-26; 16:11). "Before the LORD" means at the place where he is present.

decisions.choice: the undertaking of your hand: whatever you work at, and what it yields
decisions.reason: "Sending out the hand" is an idiom for one's work and its results (15:10; 23:21; 28:8). Israel rejoices in the harvest and herds God has made its work produce.

decisions.choice: you (plural) and you (singular): the people as a whole and each one of them
decisions.reason: The chapter moves between "you" plural and "you" singular, here within one verse. Moses speaks both to all Israel and to each Israelite as one; the meaning does not change.

decisions.choice: you and your households are to eat
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable bring "you and your households" forward to the start, so it is clear who eats and rejoices. "Families" at Readable is the plain word for the households.

decisions.choice: vocês ... te abençoou (L); vocês throughout (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verse is plural until the last clause, "has blessed you (singular)" (m3). Literal keeps the singular there; Balanced and Readable stay in the plural, Balanced dropping the second "o teu Deus" as the English does; the meaning does not change.

decisions.choice: o empreendimento da mão (L); o trabalho das suas mãos (B)
decisions.reason: The idiom of "sending out the hand" (m2): Literal keeps the hand, Balanced the familiar Portuguese "trabalho das mãos", which names both the work and what it yields.

decisions.choice: "тебя", "твой" after "вы"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew turns from the plural to the singular in mid-verse, the people as a whole and each one (m3). Literal and Balanced keep the turn with "вы" and "ты", as throughout these chapters; Readable keeps one form within a sentence where the change would only confuse.

decisions.choice: "手所做的一切" (L); "所从事的一切" (B); "辛苦得来的一切" (R)
decisions.reason: "The undertaking of your hand" is whatever one works at and what it yields (m2). Literal keeps the hand; Balanced and Readable give the sense.

decisions.choice: "kakain sa harap ng PANGINOON"
decisions.reason: A joyful meal at the sanctuary (m1), as English (en1).

decisions.choice: "lahat ng gawain ng inyong kamay" (L); "pinagpaguran" (B); "pinaghirapan" (R)
decisions.reason: Whatever you work at, and what it yields (m2).

decisions.choice: "kayo ... ka" (L)
decisions.reason: The people as a whole and each one of them (m3); Literal keeps both.

source.text: לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּן כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲנַ֧חְנוּ עֹשִׂ֛ים פֹּ֖ה הַיּ֑וֹם אִ֖ישׁ כָּל־הַיָּשָׁ֥ר בְּעֵינָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: Not you shall do according to all that we [are] doing here the day, each man all the right in his eyes,

en.L: You shall not do according to all that we are doing here today, each {{gender:one|man}} [doing] whatever [is] right in {{gender:their|his}} own eyes,
en.B: You must not do as we are doing here today, everyone doing whatever seems right to them,
en.R: Do not keep doing what we are doing here today. Now everyone does whatever they think is right.

es.L: No {{plural_you:harán|haréis}} conforme a todo lo que nosotros hacemos aquí hoy, cada {{gender:uno|hombre}} [haciendo] todo lo que [es] recto a sus propios ojos,
es.B: No {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} hacer como hacemos aquí hoy, cada uno lo que le parece bien,
es.R: No {{plural_you:sigan|sigáis}} haciendo lo que hacemos aquí hoy. Ahora cada uno hace lo que cree que está bien.

fr.L: Vous ne ferez pas selon tout ce que nous faisons ici aujourd’hui, {{gender:chacun|chaque homme}} [faisant] tout ce qui [est] droit à ses propres yeux,
fr.B: Vous ne ferez pas comme nous faisons ici aujourd’hui, chacun faisant ce qui lui semble juste,
fr.R: Ne continuez pas à faire ce que nous faisons ici aujourd’hui. En ce moment, chacun fait ce qui lui paraît juste.

sw.L: Msifanye kama yote tunayofanya hapa leo, kila mtu [akifanya] yote yaliyo sawa machoni pake mwenyewe,
sw.B: Msifanye kama tunavyofanya hapa leo, kila mtu akifanya lolote analoona kuwa sawa,
sw.R: Msiendelee kufanya kama tunavyofanya hapa leo. Sasa kila mtu anafanya chochote anachofikiri ni sawa.

vi.L: Các ngươi không được làm theo mọi điều chúng ta đang làm ở đây hôm nay, mỗi người [làm] điều gì cho là đúng trong mắt mình,
vi.B: Anh em không được làm như chúng ta đang làm ở đây hôm nay, ai nấy đều làm theo điều mình cho là phải,
vi.R: Đừng tiếp tục làm như chúng ta đang làm ở đây hôm nay. Bây giờ ai cũng làm theo điều mình cho là đúng.

ko.L: 우리가 오늘 여기서 하는 모든 것처럼, 저마다 자기 눈에 옳은 대로 [행하는] 것처럼 너희는 하지 말아라.
ko.B: 너희는 오늘 우리가 여기서 하는 것처럼, 저마다 자기 보기에 옳은 대로 해서는 안 된다.
ko.R: 오늘 우리가 여기서 하는 대로 계속하지 마십시오. 지금은 저마다 자기가 옳다고 생각하는 대로 하고 있습니다.

pt.L: Não farão conforme tudo o que nós estamos fazendo aqui hoje, cada um [fazendo] tudo o que [é] reto aos seus próprios olhos,
pt.B: Não façam como nós estamos fazendo aqui hoje, cada um fazendo o que bem lhe parece,
pt.R: Não continuem fazendo o que estamos fazendo aqui hoje. Agora cada um faz o que acha certo.

am.L: ዛሬ እዚህ እኛ እንደምናደርገው ሁሉ፣ እያንዳንዱ በዓይኑ ቅን የሆነውን ሁሉ [እያደረገ]፣ አታድርጉ፤
am.B: ዛሬ እዚህ እኛ እንደምናደርገው፣ እያንዳንዱ ትክክል መስሎ የታየውን ሁሉ እንደሚያደርግ፣ እናንተ አታድርጉ፤
am.R: ዛሬ እዚህ የምናደርገውን ማድረጋችሁን አትቀጥሉ። አሁን እያንዳንዱ ትክክል የመሰለውን ያደርጋል።

hi.L: तुम उन सब [कामों] के अनुसार न करना जो हम आज यहाँ कर रहे हैं, {{gender:हर कोई|हर पुरुष}} वही [करता है] जो उसकी अपनी आँखों में ठीक [है],
hi.B: तुम वैसा न करना जैसा हम आज यहाँ कर रहे हैं, कि हर कोई वही करता है जो उसे ठीक लगता है,
hi.R: जो हम आज यहाँ कर रहे हैं, वह करते न रहना। अभी तो हर कोई वही करता है जो उसे ठीक लगता है।

ru.L: Не делайте так, как мы делаем здесь сегодня, каждый [делает] то, что правильно в его глазах,
ru.B: Не поступайте так, как мы поступаем здесь сегодня, когда каждый делает то, что ему кажется правильным,
ru.R: Не делайте больше того, что мы делаем здесь сегодня. Сейчас каждый делает то, что считает правильным.

ja.L: あなたがたは、わたしたちが今日ここで行っているすべてのこと、すなわち、各人が自分の目に正しいことを何でも[行うこと]のとおりに行ってはならない。
ja.B: あなたがたは、今日わたしたちがここでしているように、だれもが自分で正しいと思うことをしてはならない。
ja.R: 今日ここでわたしたちがしているようなことを、続けてはいけない。今は、だれもが自分で正しいと思うことをしている。

uk.L: Не робіть так, як усе, що ми робимо тут сьогодні, кожен [робить] усе, що правильне в його очах,
uk.B: Не робіть так, як ми робимо тут сьогодні, коли кожен чинить те, що здається йому правильним,
uk.R: Не робіть більше того, що ми робимо тут сьогодні. Тепер кожен робить те, що сам вважає правильним.

id.L: Janganlah kalian berbuat seperti segala yang kita lakukan di sini pada hari ini, setiap orang [melakukan] segala yang benar di matanya sendiri,
id.B: Janganlah kalian berbuat seperti yang kita lakukan di sini hari ini, setiap orang berbuat apa saja yang dianggapnya benar,
id.R: Jangan terus melakukan apa yang kita lakukan di sini hari ini. Sekarang setiap orang melakukan apa saja yang menurutnya benar.

zh.L: 你们不可照着我们今天在这里所做的一切去做，就是各人做自己眼中看为正的事，
zh.B: 你们不可像我们今天在这里所做的那样，人人都做自己认为对的事，
zh.R: 不要再像我们今天在这里所做的那样。现在每个人都做自己认为对的事。

tl.L: Hindi ninyo gagawin ang ayon sa lahat ng ginagawa natin dito ngayon, {{gender:bawat isa|bawat lalaki}} ay gumagawa ng anumang tama sa kaniyang sariling paningin,
tl.B: Huwag ninyong gawin ang ginagawa natin dito ngayon, na ang bawat isa ay gumagawa ng anumang inaakala niyang tama,
tl.R: Huwag na ninyong ipagpatuloy ang ginagawa natin dito ngayon. Sa ngayon ay ginagawa ng bawat isa ang anumang inaakala niyang tama.

pa.L: ਤੁਸੀਂ ਉਸ ਸਭ ਦੇ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਨਾ ਕਰਨਾ ਜੋ ਅਸੀਂ ਅੱਜ ਇੱਥੇ ਕਰ ਰਹੇ ਹਾਂ, {{gender:ਹਰ ਕੋਈ|ਹਰ ਆਦਮੀ}} [ਉਹੀ ਕਰਦਾ] ਜੋ ਉਸ ਦੀਆਂ ਆਪਣੀਆਂ ਅੱਖਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਠੀਕ [ਹੈ],
pa.B: ਜਿਵੇਂ ਅਸੀਂ ਅੱਜ ਇੱਥੇ ਕਰ ਰਹੇ ਹਾਂ, ਕਿ ਹਰ ਕੋਈ ਜੋ ਆਪਣੀ ਨਜ਼ਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਠੀਕ ਸਮਝਦਾ ਹੈ ਉਹੀ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਤੁਸੀਂ ਉਸ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਨਾ ਕਰਨਾ,
pa.R: ਹੁਣ ਤਾਂ ਹਰ ਕੋਈ ਆਪਣੀ ਮਰਜ਼ੀ ਨਾਲ ਭਗਤੀ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ। ਪਰ ਉੱਥੇ ਇਉਂ ਨਾ ਕਰਨਾ।

decisions.choice: what we are doing here today: the way worship is done now, on the plains of Moab
decisions.reason: Moses includes himself. On the journey there was no settled place and no rest (verse 9), so practice was not yet ordered as it will be. The verse does not say exactly what was irregular; it may be offerings made in many places, or worship left to each person's choice.

decisions.choice: right in his own eyes: what each one thinks is right
decisions.reason: The phrase sets a person's own judgment against what God has commanded; verses 25 and 28 speak of doing what is right "in the eyes of the LORD". Judges uses it of a time with no order (Judges 17:6; 21:25).

decisions.choice: each man: each person, man or woman
decisions.reason: The word is "man", used in the sense "each one".

decisions.choice: each {{gender:one|man}} (Literal); everyone (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the traditional "man" as the setting's alternative. Balanced and Readable say "everyone", which needs no setting.

decisions.choice: "mỗi người" (L), "ai nấy" (B), "ai cũng" (R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: These words already mean every person, man or woman; Vietnamese has no man-only wording to offer as the alternative.

decisions.choice: "저마다" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The Korean word for "each one" does not mark gender, so the English setting has nothing to change here.

decisions.choice: cada um, with no gender setting
decisions.reason: The English Literal needs a setting because "each man" names only men, but the sense is each person (m3), and Portuguese "cada um" already says that.

decisions.choice: No gender span: "እያንዳንዱ" for "each man"
decisions.reason: "እያንዳንዱ" (each one) with the generic masculine already includes women in Amharic, so the English span has nothing to change here.

decisions.choice: a gender span at Literal, "हर कोई" (setting: "हर पुरुष"); "हर कोई" with no span at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: Each man means each person, man or woman (m3). Literal mirrors the English span; at Balanced and Readable "हर कोई" is already inclusive and the possessive "उसे" is the same for both, so the English span on "their" has nothing to change in Hindi.

decisions.choice: "каждый" with no span
decisions.reason: Ish here means each person, man or woman (m3). Russian "каждый" already includes everyone, so the English gender span has no Russian counterpart, as the style guide says.

decisions.choice: "各人" (Literal), "だれもが" (Balanced, Readable), with no gender span
decisions.reason: Japanese 各人 and だれ are already inclusive, so the English each one / each man setting needs no span.

decisions.choice: "кожен" with no gender span
decisions.reason: Ukrainian "кожен" already takes in men and women, so no span is added where the English has one.

decisions.choice: "各人" (L), "人人" (B), "每个人" (R), no gender span
decisions.reason: The English Literal writes each {{gender:one|man}}; Chinese "各人" already means each person, man or woman (m3), so there is no span.

decisions.choice: "自己眼中看为正的事"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture "right in his own eyes"; Balanced and Readable give its sense (m2).

decisions.choice: "ang ginagawa natin dito ngayon"
decisions.reason: The way worship is done now, on the plains of Moab (m1); *natin* takes in Moses and the people.

decisions.choice: "tama sa kaniyang sariling paningin" (L); "inaakala niyang tama" (B, R)
decisions.reason: What each one thinks is right (m2).

decisions.choice: "bawat isa" (L span; B, R plain)
decisions.reason: Each person, man or woman (m3), as English (en1); *niya* and *kaniya* name no gender.

source.text: כִּ֥י לֹא־בָּאתֶ֖ם עַד־עָ֑תָּה אֶל־הַמְּנוּחָה֙ וְאֶל־הַֽנַּחֲלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: for not you have come until now to the resting place and to the inheritance which Yahweh your God [is] giving to you.

en.L: for you have not yet come to the resting place and to the inheritance that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is giving you.
en.B: because you have not yet reached the place of rest, the inheritance that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is giving you.
en.R: That is because you have not yet come to the land of rest. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} your God is giving it to you to keep as your own.

es.L: porque no {{plural_you:han llegado|habéis llegado}} hasta ahora al lugar de reposo y a la heredad que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te da.
es.B: ya que todavía no {{plural_you:han llegado|habéis llegado}} al lugar de descanso, a la heredad que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te da.
es.R: Esto es porque todavía no {{plural_you:han entrado|habéis entrado}} en la tierra del descanso. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te la está dando para que sea tuya para siempre.

fr.L: car vous n’êtes pas venus jusqu’à présent au lieu de repos et à l’héritage que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te donne.
fr.B: puisque vous n’êtes pas encore arrivés au lieu du repos, à l’héritage que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te donne.
fr.R: En effet, vous n’êtes pas encore arrivés dans le pays du repos. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te le donne pour qu’il soit à toi pour toujours.

sw.L: kwa maana hamjafika hata sasa mahali pa pumziko na kwenye urithi ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anakupa.
sw.B: kwa sababu bado hamjafika mahali pa pumziko, yaani urithi ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anakupa.
sw.R: Hii ni kwa sababu bado hamjaingia katika nchi ya pumziko. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anakupa nchi hiyo iwe mali yako daima.

vi.L: vì ngươi chưa đến nơi an nghỉ và sản nghiệp mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi ban cho ngươi.
vi.B: vì anh em chưa vào nơi an nghỉ, là sản nghiệp mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em ban cho anh em.
vi.R: Đó là vì anh em chưa vào xứ an nghỉ. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em đang ban xứ ấy cho anh em làm sản nghiệp đời đời.

ko.L: 너희가 아직 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너에게 주시는 안식처와 유산에 이르지 못하였기 때문이다.
ko.B: 너희가 아직 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희에게 주시는 쉼의 땅, 곧 유산으로 받을 땅에 이르지 못했기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그것은 여러분이 아직 편히 쉴 땅에 들어가지 못했기 때문입니다. 그 땅은 여러분의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 여러분의 것으로 삼도록 주시는 땅입니다.

pt.L: pois ainda não entraram no descanso e na herança que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, te dá.
pt.B: porque vocês ainda não chegaram ao lugar de descanso, à herança que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, está dando a vocês.
pt.R: Isso porque vocês ainda não chegaram à terra do descanso. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, está dando essa terra a vocês para ser de vocês.

am.L: አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ወደሚሰጥህ ማረፊያና ርስት እስከ አሁን አልገባችሁምና።
am.B: ወደ ዕረፍቱ ስፍራ፣ አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ወደሚሰጥህ ርስት ገና አልደረሳችሁምና።
am.R: ይህም የሆነው ገና ወደ ዕረፍቱ ምድር ስላልገባችሁ ነው። አምላካችሁ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለዘለቄታው የራሳችሁ እንድትሆን ይሰጣችኋል።

hi.L: क्योंकि अब तक तुम उस विश्राम-स्थान और उस निज भाग में नहीं पहुँचे जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर तुम्हें दे रहे हैं।
hi.B: क्योंकि अब तक तुम उस विश्राम के स्थान में, उस निज भाग में, नहीं पहुँचे जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर तुम्हें दे रहे हैं।
hi.R: इसका कारण यह है कि तुम अब तक उस देश में नहीं पहुँचे जहाँ तुम चैन से रहोगे। {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर उसे तुम्हें दे रहे हैं कि वह सदा तुम्हारा रहे।

ru.L: потому что вы ещё не пришли к покою и к наделу, который {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог, даёт тебе.
ru.B: ведь вы ещё не достигли места покоя, того удела, который {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог, даёт тебе.
ru.R: Ведь вы ещё не пришли в землю, где будете жить спокойно. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, ваш Бог, даёт её вам, чтобы она была вашей навсегда.

ja.L: なぜなら、あなたがたはまだ、あなたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}があなたに与えようとしておられる安息の場所と嗣業に来ていないからである。
ja.B: あなたがたはまだ、あなたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が与えようとしておられる安息の地、すなわち嗣業の地に着いていないからである。
ja.R: それは、あなたたちがまだ、安心して住める土地に来ていないからである。あなたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、その土地をあなたたちに与えて、いつまでも自分の分の土地としてくださる。

uk.L: бо ви досі не прийшли до місця спочинку і до спадку, який {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, дає тобі.
uk.B: бо ви ще не дійшли до місця спочинку, до спадку, який {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, тобі дає.
uk.R: Це тому, що ви ще не прийшли до краю спочинку. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, дає його тобі, щоб він був твій назавжди.

id.L: sebab kalian belum sampai ke tempat perhentian dan ke milik pusaka yang diberikan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allahmu, kepadamu.
id.B: sebab kalian belum sampai ke tempat perhentian, yaitu milik pusaka yang diberikan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allahmu, kepadamu.
id.R: Itu karena kalian belum sampai ke negeri tempat kalian akan hidup tenang. {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah kalian, sedang memberikannya kepada kalian menjadi milik kalian.

zh.L: 因为你们到现在还没有来到那安息之所和那产业，就是{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你的{{god_term:神|上帝}}要赐给你的。
zh.B: 因为你们还没有到达那安息之地，就是{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你的{{god_term:神|上帝}}要赐给你的产业。
zh.R: 这是因为你们还没有来到那块安息之地。{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你的{{god_term:神|上帝}}要把那地赐给你，让你永远拥有。

tl.L: sapagkat hindi pa kayo nakararating sa pahingahang lugar at sa manang ibinibigay sa iyo {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} iyong Diyos.
tl.B: sapagkat hindi pa kayo nakararating sa lugar ng kapahingahan, ang manang ibinibigay sa inyo {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos.
tl.R: Ganoon ito sapagkat hindi pa kayo nakararating sa lupain ng kapahingahan. Ibinibigay ito sa inyo {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos upang maging inyo magpakailanman.

pa.L: ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਅਜੇ ਤੱਕ ਉਸ ਅਰਾਮ ਦੀ ਥਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਮੀਰਾਸ ਤੱਕ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਹੁੰਚੇ ਜਿਹੜੀ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਤੇਰੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਦੇ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ।
pa.B: ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਹਾਲੇ ਉਸ ਅਰਾਮ ਦੇ ਟਿਕਾਣੇ ਉੱਤੇ, ਉਸ ਮੀਰਾਸ ਉੱਤੇ, ਨਹੀਂ ਪਹੁੰਚੇ ਜਿਹੜੀ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਦੇ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ।
pa.R: ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਅਜੇ ਉਸ ਦੇਸ਼ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਹੁੰਚੇ ਜਿਹੜਾ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਦੇ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ, ਜਿੱਥੇ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਚੈਨ ਮਿਲੇਗਾ।

decisions.choice: the resting place: a settled home, free from wandering and from enemies
decisions.reason: The word means rest or a place of rest. Here it is the land where Israel will settle, with its enemies held off (verse 10; 1 Kings 8:56). Psalm 95:11 recalls it: "they shall not enter my rest".

decisions.choice: the inheritance: the land as a lasting family possession, given by God
decisions.reason: An inheritance is property that stays in a family from one generation to the next. Israel's land is called this because God gives it and it is to remain theirs (4:21; 15:4).

decisions.choice: the place of rest, the inheritance (Balanced); the land of rest ... to keep as your own (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable take the two nouns as two names for one land, which the verse's "which" implies. Readable explains "inheritance" in plain words.

decisions.choice: vocês throughout (B, R); te dá (L)
decisions.reason: The verse begins in the plural and ends with the land formula in the singular. Literal keeps "o teu Deus, te dá"; Balanced and Readable give the formula its plural form, "está dando a vocês" (1:20), since the sentence speaks to "vocês".

decisions.choice: "निज भाग" for the inheritance
decisions.reason: The inheritance is the land as a lasting family possession given by God (m2). "निज भाग" is the term of Numbers; Readable says what it means.

decisions.choice: "надел" (L), "удел" (B)
decisions.reason: Nahalah is the land as a lasting family holding given by God (m2). "Наследие" now means a legacy or heritage; "надел" and "удел" name an allotted share of land.

decisions.choice: nachalah "嗣業" (Literal, Balanced), "いつまでも自分の分の土地" (Readable), as NUM 32
decisions.reason: The book-wide form for the land as a family's lasting share from God.

decisions.choice: "安息之所" (L), "安息之地" (B, R); "产业" (L, B), "让你永远拥有" (R)
decisions.reason: A settled home, free from wandering and from enemies (m1), and the land as a lasting possession given by God (m2). Readable says "inheritance" in plain words.

decisions.choice: "pahingahang lugar" (L); "lugar ng kapahingahan" (B); "lupain ng kapahingahan" (R)
decisions.reason: A settled home, free from wandering and from enemies (m1), as English (en1).

decisions.choice: "mana"; "upang maging inyo magpakailanman" (R)
decisions.reason: The land as a lasting family possession, given by God (m2), as English (en1).

source.text: וַעֲבַרְתֶּם֮ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן֒ וִֽישַׁבְתֶּ֣ם בָּאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם מַנְחִ֣יל אֶתְכֶ֑ם וְהֵנִ֨יחַ לָכֶ֧ם מִכָּל־אֹיְבֵיכֶ֛ם מִסָּבִ֖יב וִֽישַׁבְתֶּם־בֶּֽטַח׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will cross the Jordan and you will live in the land which Yahweh your God [is] causing to inherit you, and he will give rest to you from all your enemies from around, and you will live [in] security,

en.L: But you will cross the Jordan and live in the land that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is giving you to inherit, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will give you rest from all your enemies around [you], and you will live in security,
en.B: But you will cross the Jordan and settle in the land that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is giving you as an inheritance. He will give you rest from all the enemies around you, and you will live in safety,
en.R: But you will cross the Jordan River and live in the land that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is giving you. He will keep you safe from all the enemies around you, and you will live without fear.

es.L: Pero {{plural_you:cruzarán|cruzaréis}} el Jordán y {{plural_you:habitarán|habitaréis}} en la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} {{plural_you:les|os}} da en heredad, y {{plural_you:les|os}} dará reposo de todos {{plural_you:sus enemigos|vuestros enemigos}} de alrededor, y {{plural_you:habitarán|habitaréis}} seguros,
es.B: Pero {{plural_you:cruzarán|cruzaréis}} el Jordán y {{plural_you:se establecerán|os estableceréis}} en la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} {{plural_you:les|os}} da como heredad. {{plural_you:Les|Os}} dará descanso de todos los enemigos que {{plural_you:los|os}} rodean, y {{plural_you:vivirán|viviréis}} a salvo,
es.R: Pero {{plural_you:cruzarán|cruzaréis}} el río Jordán y {{plural_you:vivirán|viviréis}} en la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} {{plural_you:les|os}} da. Él {{plural_you:los|os}} protegerá de todos los enemigos que {{plural_you:los|os}} rodean, y {{plural_you:vivirán|viviréis}} sin miedo.

fr.L: Mais vous passerez le Jourdain et vous habiterez dans le pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu vous donne en héritage, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous donnera du repos face à tous vos ennemis d’alentour, et vous habiterez en sécurité,
fr.B: Mais vous passerez le Jourdain et vous vous installerez dans le pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu vous donne en héritage. Il vous accordera le repos en vous mettant à l’abri de tous les ennemis qui vous entourent, et vous vivrez en sécurité,
fr.R: Mais vous traverserez le fleuve Jourdain et vous vivrez dans le pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu vous donne. Il vous protégera de tous les ennemis qui vous entourent, et vous vivrez sans crainte.

sw.L: Lakini mtavuka Yordani na kukaa katika nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu anawarithisha, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} atawapa pumziko mbali na adui zenu wote wanaowazunguka, nanyi mtakaa salama,
sw.B: Lakini mtavuka Yordani na kuishi katika nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu anawapa kuwa urithi. Atawapa pumziko mbali na adui wote wanaowazunguka, nanyi mtaishi kwa usalama,
sw.R: Lakini mtavuka Mto Yordani na kuishi katika nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu anawapa. Atawalinda na adui wote wanaowazunguka, nanyi mtaishi bila hofu.

vi.L: Nhưng các ngươi sẽ qua sông Giô-đanh và sống trong xứ mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi cho các ngươi thừa hưởng, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ cho các ngươi được an nghỉ khỏi mọi kẻ thù chung quanh, và các ngươi sẽ sống yên ổn,
vi.B: Nhưng anh em sẽ qua sông Giô-đanh và định cư trong xứ mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em ban cho anh em làm sản nghiệp. Ngài sẽ cho anh em được an nghỉ khỏi mọi kẻ thù chung quanh, và anh em sẽ sống bình yên,
vi.R: Nhưng anh em sẽ qua sông Giô-đanh và sống trong xứ mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em đang ban cho anh em. Ngài sẽ giữ anh em an toàn khỏi mọi kẻ thù chung quanh, và anh em sẽ sống không còn sợ hãi.

ko.L: 그러나 너희가 요단강을 건너 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희에게 유산으로 주시는 땅에 살게 되고, 그분께서 너희 사방의 모든 원수에게서 너희를 쉬게 하셔서 너희가 안전하게 살게 되면,
ko.B: 그러나 너희가 요단강을 건너 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희에게 유산으로 주시는 땅에 자리 잡고, 그분께서 너희 주위의 모든 원수로부터 너희에게 안식을 주셔서 너희가 평안히 살게 되면,
ko.R: 그러나 여러분은 요단강을 건너서 여러분의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 주시는 땅에서 살게 될 것입니다. 그분께서 여러분을 둘러싼 모든 원수에게서 여러분을 지켜 주셔서, 여러분은 두려움 없이 살게 될 것입니다.

pt.L: Mas vocês atravessarão o Jordão e habitarão na terra que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, dá a vocês como herança, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes dará descanso de todos os seus inimigos ao redor, e vocês habitarão em segurança,
pt.B: Mas vocês atravessarão o Jordão e se estabelecerão na terra que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, está dando a vocês como herança. Ele lhes dará descanso de todos os inimigos que os cercam, e vocês viverão em segurança,
pt.R: Mas vocês vão atravessar o rio Jordão e morar na terra que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, está dando a vocês. Ele vai proteger vocês de todos os inimigos ao redor, e vocês vão viver sem medo.

am.L: ነገር ግን ዮርዳኖስን ትሻገራላችሁ፤ አምላካችሁ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በሚያወርሳችሁ ምድር ትኖራላችሁ፤ በዙሪያችሁ ካሉት ጠላቶቻችሁ ሁሉ ያሳርፋችኋል፤ ተማምናችሁም ትኖራላችሁ፤
am.B: ነገር ግን ዮርዳኖስን ተሻግራችሁ አምላካችሁ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ርስት አድርጎ በሚሰጣችሁ ምድር ትሰፍራላችሁ። በዙሪያችሁ ካሉት ጠላቶቻችሁ ሁሉ ዕረፍት ይሰጣችኋል፤ በሰላምም ትኖራላችሁ፤
am.R: ነገር ግን የዮርዳኖስን ወንዝ ተሻግራችሁ አምላካችሁ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በሚሰጣችሁ ምድር ትኖራላችሁ። በዙሪያችሁ ካሉት ጠላቶች ሁሉ ይጠብቃችኋል፤ ያለ ፍርሃትም ትኖራላችሁ።

hi.L: परंतु तुम यरदन पार करोगे और उस देश में बसोगे जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर तुम्हें निज भाग में दे रहे हैं, और वे तुम्हें चारों ओर के तुम्हारे सब शत्रुओं से विश्राम देंगे, और तुम निडर बसे रहोगे,
hi.B: परंतु तुम यरदन पार करोगे और उस देश में बस जाओगे जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर तुम्हें निज भाग के रूप में दे रहे हैं। वे तुम्हें चारों ओर के सब शत्रुओं से विश्राम देंगे, और तुम सुरक्षित रहोगे,
hi.R: परंतु तुम यरदन नदी पार करोगे और उस देश में रहोगे जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर तुम्हें दे रहे हैं। वे तुम्हें आसपास के सब शत्रुओं से बचाए रखेंगे, और तुम बिना डर के रहोगे।

ru.L: Но вы перейдёте Иордан и будете жить в земле, которую {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, ваш Бог, даёт вам в надел, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} даст вам покой от всех ваших врагов вокруг, и вы будете жить в безопасности,
ru.B: Но вы перейдёте Иордан и поселитесь в земле, которую {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, ваш Бог, даёт вам в удел. Он даст вам покой от всех окружающих вас врагов, и вы будете жить в безопасности,
ru.R: Но вы перейдёте реку Иордан и будете жить в земле, которую даёт вам {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, ваш Бог. Он защитит вас от всех врагов вокруг, и вы будете жить без страха.

ja.L: しかし、あなたがたはヨルダン[川]を渡り、あなたがたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}があなたがたに受け継がせようとしておられる地に住み、[神は]周りのすべての敵からあなたがたに安息を与えられ、あなたがたは安らかに住む。
ja.B: しかし、あなたがたはヨルダン川を渡り、あなたがたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が嗣業として与えようとしておられる地に住むようになる。神は周りのすべての敵からあなたがたを守って安息を与えられ、あなたがたは安らかに暮らすようになる。
ja.R: しかし、あなたたちはヨルダン川を渡って、あなたたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が与えてくださる土地に住むようになる。神は、周りのすべての敵からあなたたちを守ってくださり、あなたたちは何も恐れずに暮らせるようになる。

uk.L: Але ви перейдете Йордан і житимете в краю, який {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, ваш Бог, дає вам у спадок, і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} дасть вам спокій від усіх ваших ворогів довкола, і ви житимете безпечно,
uk.B: Але ви перейдете Йордан і оселитеся в краю, який {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, ваш Бог, дає вам у спадок. Він дасть вам спокій від усіх ворогів довкола, і ви житимете в безпеці,
uk.R: Але ви перейдете річку Йордан і житимете в краю, який {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, ваш Бог, вам дає. Він захистить вас від усіх ворогів довкола, і ви житимете без страху.

id.L: Tetapi kalian akan menyeberangi sungai Yordan dan diam di negeri yang diberikan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah kalian, kepada kalian menjadi milik pusaka, dan {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} akan memberikan keamanan kepada kalian dari semua musuh kalian di sekeliling, dan kalian akan diam dengan tenteram,
id.B: Tetapi kalian akan menyeberangi sungai Yordan dan menetap di negeri yang diberikan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah kalian, kepada kalian menjadi milik pusaka. Dia akan memberikan keamanan kepada kalian dari semua musuh di sekeliling kalian, dan kalian akan hidup dengan tenteram,
id.R: Tetapi kalian akan menyeberangi sungai Yordan dan tinggal di negeri yang diberikan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah kalian, kepada kalian. Dia akan melindungi kalian dari semua musuh di sekeliling kalian, dan kalian akan hidup tanpa rasa takut.

zh.L: 但你们要过约旦河，住在{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你们的{{god_term:神|上帝}}使你们承受为业的地上；{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}要使你们得享安宁，不受四围一切仇敌[的侵扰]，你们就安然居住，
zh.B: 但你们要过约旦河，定居在{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你们的{{god_term:神|上帝}}赐给你们作产业的地上。{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}要使你们得享太平，不受四周一切仇敌的侵扰，你们就安然居住，
zh.R: 但你们要过约旦河，住在{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你们的{{god_term:神|上帝}}赐给你们的地上。{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}会保护你们，不受四周一切仇敌的伤害，你们就可以安心地生活。

tl.L: Ngunit tatawid kayo sa Jordan at maninirahan sa lupaing ipinamamana sa inyo {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos, at bibigyan {{deity_pronoun:niya|Niya}} kayo ng kapahingahan mula sa lahat ng inyong mga kaaway sa palibot, at maninirahan kayo nang panatag,
tl.B: Ngunit tatawid kayo sa Jordan at maninirahan sa lupaing ibinibigay sa inyo {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos bilang mana. Bibigyan {{deity_pronoun:niya|Niya}} kayo ng kapahingahan mula sa lahat ng kaaway sa palibot ninyo, at maninirahan kayo nang ligtas,
tl.R: Ngunit tatawid kayo sa Ilog Jordan at maninirahan sa lupaing ibinibigay sa inyo {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos. Iingatan {{deity_pronoun:niya|Niya}} kayo mula sa lahat ng kaaway sa palibot ninyo, at mamumuhay kayo nang walang takot.

pa.L: ਪਰ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਯਰਦਨ ਦੇ ਪਾਰ ਲੰਘੋਗੇ ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਦੇਸ਼ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੱਸੋਗੇ ਜਿਹੜਾ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਮੀਰਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਦੇ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ, ਅਤੇ ਉਹ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਆਲੇ-ਦੁਆਲੇ ਦੇ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਵੈਰੀਆਂ ਤੋਂ ਅਰਾਮ ਦੇਣਗੇ, ਅਤੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਆ ਨਾਲ ਵੱਸੋਗੇ,
pa.B: ਪਰ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਯਰਦਨ ਪਾਰ ਕਰ ਕੇ ਉਸ ਦੇਸ਼ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੱਸ ਜਾਓਗੇ ਜਿਹੜਾ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਵਿਰਸੇ ਵਜੋਂ ਦੇ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ। ਉਹ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਚੁਫ਼ੇਰੇ ਦੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਦੁਸ਼ਮਣਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਛੁਟਕਾਰਾ ਦੇਣਗੇ, ਅਤੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਬੇਖ਼ੌਫ਼ ਰਹੋਗੇ,
pa.R: ਪਰ ਛੇਤੀ ਹੀ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਯਰਦਨ ਨਦੀ ਪਾਰ ਕਰੋਗੇ ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਦੇਸ਼ ਵਿੱਚ ਰਹਿਣ ਲੱਗੋਗੇ ਜਿਹੜਾ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਦੇ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ। ਚਾਰੇ ਪਾਸੇ ਦੇ ਦੁਸ਼ਮਣਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਉਹ ਤੁਹਾਡੀ ਰੱਖਿਆ ਕਰਨਗੇ, ਅਤੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਅਮਨ ਨਾਲ ਰਹੋਗੇ।

decisions.choice: and you will cross: the time to come, which sets the scene for verse 11
decisions.reason: The verbs speak of the future, after the crossing. Verse 11 says what will follow once Israel lives in the land in safety: then the place God chooses will be the only place for offerings.

decisions.choice: give rest from enemies; live in security: peace on every side
decisions.reason: God's giving of "rest" means an end to war with the neighboring peoples (25:19; Joshua 21:44; 2 Samuel 7:1). "In security" means without danger or fear. The same promise is made in Leviticus 25:18-19.

decisions.choice: the Jordan River
decisions.reason: Readable adds "River" so the name is clear.

decisions.choice: "Ngunit tatawid kayo"; "Ilog Jordan" (R)
decisions.reason: The time to come, which sets the scene for verse 11 (m1), as English (en1).

decisions.choice: "kapahingahan mula sa ... mga kaaway ... nang panatag"
decisions.reason: Peace on every side (m2).

source.text: וְהָיָ֣ה הַמָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁר־יִבְחַר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֥ם בּוֹ֙ לְשַׁכֵּ֤ן שְׁמוֹ֙ שָׁ֔ם שָׁ֣מָּה תָבִ֔יאוּ אֵ֛ת כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י מְצַוֶּ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֑ם עוֹלֹתֵיכֶ֣ם וְזִבְחֵיכֶ֗ם מַעְשְׂרֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ וּתְרֻמַ֣ת יֶדְכֶ֔ם וְכֹל֙ מִבְחַ֣ר נִדְרֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּדְּר֖וּ לַֽיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: and it will be: the place which will choose Yahweh your God in it to make dwell his name there, there you shall bring all that I [am] commanding you: your burnt offerings and your sacrifices, your tithes and [the] contribution of your hand, and all [the] choice of your vows which you will vow to Yahweh.

en.L: then it shall be [that] to the place that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God will choose to make {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name dwell there, there you shall bring all that I am commanding you: your burnt offerings and your sacrifices, your tithes and the contribution of your hand, and all the choicest of your vow offerings that you vow to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: then you are to bring everything I am commanding you to the place that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God will choose as a dwelling for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name: your burnt offerings and your sacrifices, your tithes and the gifts you set apart, and all the fine offerings you vow to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Then you must bring everything I command you to the place that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God will choose as the home for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name. Bring your burnt offerings and other sacrifices, the tenth of your crops, your special gifts, and the best things you promised to give {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: entonces sucederá [que] al lugar que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} escoja para hacer habitar allí {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre, allí {{plural_you:traerán|traeréis}} todo lo que yo {{plural_you:les|os}} mando: {{plural_you:sus holocaustos y sus sacrificios, sus diezmos|vuestros holocaustos y vuestros sacrificios, vuestros diezmos}} y la ofrenda alzada de {{plural_you:su mano|vuestra mano}}, y todo lo escogido de {{plural_you:sus ofrendas votivas|vuestras ofrendas votivas}} que {{plural_you:prometan|prometáis}} con voto {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: entonces {{plural_you:deberán|deberéis}} llevar todo lo que {{plural_you:les|os}} mando al lugar que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} escoja como morada para {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre: {{plural_you:sus holocaustos y sus sacrificios, sus diezmos|vuestros holocaustos y vuestros sacrificios, vuestros diezmos}} y las contribuciones que {{plural_you:apartan|apartáis}}, y las mejores ofrendas que {{plural_you:prometan|prometáis}} con voto {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: Entonces {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} llevar todo lo que {{plural_you:les|os}} mando al lugar que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} escoja como hogar para {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre. {{plural_you:Lleven|Llevad}} {{plural_you:sus holocaustos y sus demás sacrificios|vuestros holocaustos y vuestros demás sacrificios}}, la décima parte de {{plural_you:sus cosechas|vuestras cosechas}}, {{plural_you:sus ofrendas especiales|vuestras ofrendas especiales}} y lo mejor de lo que {{plural_you:prometieron|prometisteis}} dar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

fr.L: alors il arrivera [que] le lieu que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu choisira pour y faire demeurer {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom, c’est là que vous apporterez tout ce que je vous commande : vos holocaustes et vos sacrifices, vos dîmes et l’offrande élevée de votre main, et tout le meilleur de vos offrandes votives que vous promettrez par vœu {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.
fr.B: alors vous apporterez tout ce que je vous commande au lieu que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu choisira comme demeure pour {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom : vos holocaustes et vos sacrifices, vos dîmes et les contributions que vous mettez à part, et les plus belles offrandes que vous promettez par vœu {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Alors vous devrez apporter tout ce que je vous commande au lieu que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu choisira comme maison pour {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom. Apportez vos holocaustes et vos autres sacrifices, le dixième de vos récoltes, vos dons spéciaux, et les meilleures choses que vous avez promis de donner {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.

sw.L: ndipo itakuwa ya kwamba mahali atakapopachagua {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu ili kulifanya jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} likae huko, huko ndiko mtakakoleta yote ninayowaamuru: sadaka zenu za kuteketezwa na dhabihu zenu, mafungu yenu ya kumi na sadaka ya kuinuliwa ya mkono wenu, na sadaka zenu zote bora za nadhiri mtakazomwahidi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: ndipo mtaleta kila kitu ninachowaamuru mahali ambapo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu atapachagua kuwa makao ya jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}: sadaka zenu za kuteketezwa na dhabihu zenu, mafungu yenu ya kumi na michango mnayoitenga, na sadaka zote bora mnazomwahidi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa nadhiri.
sw.R: Ndipo mtapaswa kuleta kila kitu ninachowaamuru mahali ambapo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu atapachagua ili jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} likae huko. Leteni sadaka zenu za kuteketezwa na dhabihu nyingine, sehemu ya kumi ya mazao yenu, zawadi zenu maalum, na vitu bora mlivyoahidi kumpa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: thì nơi mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi sẽ chọn để cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngự ở đó, chính nơi đó các ngươi phải đem đến mọi điều ta truyền cho các ngươi: các của lễ thiêu, các sinh tế, các phần mười, của lễ dâng riêng của tay các ngươi, và mọi lễ vật khấn nguyện tốt nhất mà các ngươi khấn nguyện với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: thì anh em phải đem mọi thứ tôi truyền cho anh em đến nơi mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em sẽ chọn làm chỗ ngự cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: các của lễ thiêu và sinh tế, các phần mười và của lễ dâng riêng, cùng mọi lễ vật tốt nhất anh em đã khấn nguyện dâng lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Bấy giờ anh em phải đem mọi thứ tôi truyền cho anh em đến nơi mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em sẽ chọn làm nhà cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Hãy đem các của lễ thiêu và những sinh tế khác, một phần mười hoa lợi, những lễ vật đặc biệt, và những thứ tốt nhất anh em đã hứa dâng lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 이름을 거기에 머물게 하시려고 택하실 그곳으로, 내가 너희에게 명령하는 모든 것, 곧 너희의 번제물과 너희의 희생 제물과 너희의 십분의 일과 너희 손으로 들어 바치는 제물과 너희가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 서원한 모든 좋은 서원 제물을 가져가거라.
ko.B: 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 이름을 두시려고 택하실 곳으로, 내가 너희에게 명령하는 모든 것을 가져가거라. 곧 번제물과 희생 제물, 십분의 일과 들어 바치는 제물, 그리고 너희가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 서원한 가장 좋은 제물을 가져가거라.
ko.R: 그때에 여러분은 제가 명령하는 모든 것을 여러분의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 이름을 두시려고 택하실 곳으로 가져가야 합니다. 번제물과 그 밖의 제물, 수확의 십분의 일, 특별한 예물, 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 바치겠다고 약속한 가장 좋은 것들을 가져가십시오.

pt.L: então será [que] ao lugar que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, escolher para fazer habitar ali o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome, para lá vocês trarão tudo o que eu lhes ordeno: os seus holocaustos e os seus sacrifícios, os seus dízimos e a oferta alçada da sua mão, e todo o melhor das suas ofertas votivas que vocês prometerem {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.
pt.B: então levem tudo o que eu lhes ordeno ao lugar que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, escolher como habitação para o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome: os seus holocaustos e os seus sacrifícios, os seus dízimos e as suas contribuições, e as melhores ofertas que vocês prometerem {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} em voto.
pt.R: Então vocês devem levar tudo o que eu ordeno ao lugar que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, escolher como morada para o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome. Levem os seus holocaustos e os outros sacrifícios, a décima parte das suas colheitas, as suas ofertas especiais e as melhores coisas que vocês prometeram dar {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.

am.L: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ አምላካችሁ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ስሙን በዚያ ያሳድር ዘንድ ወደሚመርጠው ስፍራ፣ ወደዚያ የማዝዛችሁን ሁሉ ታመጣላችሁ፤ የሚቃጠሉ መሥዋዕቶቻችሁንና መሥዋዕቶቻችሁን፣ አሥራቶቻችሁንና የእጃችሁን የሚነሣ መባ፣ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} የምትሳሉትንም ምርጥ የስእለት መባችሁን ሁሉ።
am.B: በዚያን ጊዜ የማዝዛችሁን ሁሉ አምላካችሁ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ስሙ እንዲያድርበት ወደሚመርጠው ስፍራ አምጡ፤ የሚቃጠሉ መሥዋዕቶቻችሁንና መሥዋዕቶቻችሁን፣ አሥራቶቻችሁንና ለይታችሁ የምታቀርቡትን መባ፣ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} የምትሳሉትንም ምርጥ የስእለት መባ ሁሉ።
am.R: ከዚያም የማዝዛችሁን ሁሉ አምላካችሁ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለስሙ መኖሪያ እንዲሆን ወደሚመርጠው ስፍራ ማምጣት አለባችሁ። የሚቃጠሉ መሥዋዕቶቻችሁንና ሌሎች መሥዋዕቶቻችሁን፣ የሰብላችሁን አንድ አሥረኛ፣ ልዩ ስጦታዎቻችሁንና {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ለመስጠት የተሳላችሁትን ምርጥ ነገር አምጡ።

hi.L: तब ऐसा होगा [कि] जिस स्थान को {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर अपना नाम वहाँ बसाने के लिए चुनेंगे, वहीं तुम वह सब ले जाना जिसकी आज्ञा मैं तुम्हें दे रहा हूँ: अपनी होमबलियाँ और अपने बलिदान, अपने दशमांश और अपने हाथ की उठाई हुई भेंट, और अपनी मन्नत की सब उत्तम भेंटें जिनकी मन्नत तुम {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए मानो।
hi.B: तब जिस स्थान को {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर अपने नाम के निवास के लिए चुनेंगे, वहीं तुम वह सब ले जाना जिसकी आज्ञा मैं तुम्हें दे रहा हूँ: अपनी होमबलियाँ और अपने बलिदान, अपने दशमांश और अलग की हुई भेंटें, और वे सब उत्तम भेंटें जिनकी मन्नत तुम {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए मानो।
hi.R: तब जिस जगह को {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर अपने नाम का घर होने के लिए चुनेंगे, वहीं तुम वह सब ले जाना जिसकी आज्ञा मैं तुम्हें देता हूँ। अपनी होमबलियाँ और दूसरे बलिदान, अपनी उपज का दसवाँ भाग, अपनी विशेष भेंटें, और वे सबसे अच्छी चीज़ें वहाँ ले जाना जिन्हें {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को देने की तुमने मन्नत मानी हो।

ru.L: то будет: [на] место, которое изберёт {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, ваш Бог, чтобы поселить там своё имя, туда приносите всё, что я заповедую вам: ваши всесожжения и ваши жертвы, ваши десятины и возношение вашей руки, и всё лучшее из ваших обетов, которые вы дадите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}.
ru.B: тогда приносите всё, что я вам повелеваю, на место, которое {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, ваш Бог, изберёт, чтобы поселить там своё имя: свои всесожжения и жертвы, свои десятины и приношения, которые вы отделяете, и все лучшие дары, которые вы по обету обещаете {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Тогда приносите всё, что я вам повелеваю, на место, которое {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, ваш Бог, выберет, чтобы там пребывало {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} имя. Приносите свои всесожжения и другие жертвы, десятую часть урожая, особые дары и самое лучшее из того, что вы обещали дать {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}.

ja.L: そのとき、あなたがたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がその名をそこに住まわせるために選ばれる場所、そこにあなたがたは、わたしがあなたがたに命じるすべてのものを携えて行かなければならない。あなたがたの焼き尽くすささげ物と、あなたがたのいけにえ、あなたがたの十分の一と、あなたがたの手の献納物、そして、あなたがたが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に誓う、あなたがたの誓願のささげ物の最上のものすべてを。
ja.B: そのときには、わたしが命じるすべてのものを、あなたがたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がご自分の名を住まわせるために選ばれる場所に携えて行きなさい。焼き尽くすささげ物といけにえ、十分の一と取り分けたささげ物、そして{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に誓ったえり抜きの誓願のささげ物を、すべて携えて行きなさい。
ja.R: そのときには、わたしが命じる物を、すべて、あなたたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がご自分の名の住まいとして選ばれる場所に持って行きなさい。焼いてささげるいけにえやほかのいけにえ、作物の十分の一、特別なささげ物、そして、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}にささげると誓った物の中でいちばん良い物を持って行きなさい。

uk.L: і буде: місце, яке вибере {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, ваш Бог, щоб оселити там своє імʼя, — туди приносьте все, що я наказую вам: ваші всепалення, і ваші жертви, ваші десятини, і приношення вашої руки, і все найкраще з ваших обітних жертв, які ви обіцяєте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}.
uk.B: тоді приносьте все, що я вам наказую, до місця, яке {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, ваш Бог, вибере як оселю для свого імені: свої всепалення й жертви, десятини й дари, які відкладаєте, і всі добірні обітні жертви, які обіцяєте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Тоді ви мусите приносити все, що я вам наказую, до місця, яке {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, ваш Бог, вибере як домівку для свого імені. Приносьте свої всепалення та інші жертви, десяту частину врожаю, особливі дари й найкраще з того, що ви пообіцяли дати {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}.

id.L: ke tempat yang akan dipilih {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah kalian, untuk membuat nama-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}} berdiam di sana, ke sanalah kalian harus membawa segala yang aku perintahkan kepada kalian: korban-korban bakaran kalian dan korban-korban sembelihan kalian, persepuluhan kalian dan persembahan khusus tangan kalian, dan segala korban nazar pilihan kalian yang kalian nazarkan kepada {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}.
id.B: lalu kalian harus membawa segala yang aku perintahkan kepada kalian ke tempat yang akan dipilih {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah kalian, sebagai kediaman bagi nama-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}: korban bakaran dan korban sembelihan kalian, persepuluhan dan persembahan khusus kalian, dan segala persembahan terbaik yang kalian nazarkan kepada {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}.
id.R: Pada waktu itu kalian harus membawa segala yang aku perintahkan kepada kalian ke tempat yang akan dipilih {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah kalian, sebagai kediaman bagi nama-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}. Bawalah korban bakaran dan korban-korban lain, sepersepuluh dari hasil panen kalian, persembahan khusus kalian, dan barang-barang terbaik yang kalian janjikan kepada {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}.

zh.L: 那时，{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你们的{{god_term:神|上帝}}所选择、使{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}的名居住在那里的地方，你们要把我所吩咐你们的一切都带到那里：你们的燔祭、你们的祭物、你们的十分之一、你们手中的举祭，以及你们向{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}许愿献上的一切上好的许愿祭。
zh.B: 那时，你们要把我吩咐你们的一切，都带到{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你们的{{god_term:神|上帝}}所选择、作为{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}名的居所的地方：你们的燔祭和祭物、你们的十分之一和分别出来的举祭，以及你们许愿献给{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}的一切上好的祭物。
zh.R: 那时你们必须把我吩咐你们的一切，都带到{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你们的{{god_term:神|上帝}}所选择、让{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}的名住在那里的地方。要带去你们的全烧的祭和其他的祭，你们农作物的十分之一，你们特别献上的礼物，还有你们许愿要献给{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}的最好的东西。

tl.L: ay mangyayari na sa lugar na pipiliin {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos upang patahanin doon ang {{deity_pronoun:kaniyang|Kaniyang}} pangalan, doon ninyo dadalhin ang lahat ng iniuutos ko sa inyo: ang inyong mga handog na sinusunog at ang inyong mga hain, ang inyong mga ikasampung bahagi at ang ambag ng inyong kamay, at ang lahat ng pinakamainam sa inyong mga panata na inyong ipinapanata {{divine_name:sa PANGINOON|kay Yahweh}}.
tl.B: ay dalhin ninyo ang lahat ng iniuutos ko sa inyo sa lugar na pipiliin {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos bilang tahanan ng {{deity_pronoun:kaniyang|Kaniyang}} pangalan: ang inyong mga handog na sinusunog at ang inyong mga hain, ang inyong mga ikasampung bahagi at ang mga ambag na inyong ibinukod, at ang lahat ng piling handog na ipinapanata ninyo {{divine_name:sa PANGINOON|kay Yahweh}}.
tl.R: Sa panahong iyon ay dapat ninyong dalhin ang lahat ng iniuutos ko sa inyo sa lugar na pipiliin {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos bilang tahanan ng {{deity_pronoun:kaniyang|Kaniyang}} pangalan. Dalhin ninyo ang inyong mga handog na sinusunog at iba pang mga hain, ang ikasampung bahagi ng inyong ani, ang inyong natatanging mga kaloob, at ang pinakamainam na mga bagay na ipinangako ninyong ibibigay {{divine_name:sa PANGINOON|kay Yahweh}}.

pa.L: ਤਦ ਇਉਂ ਹੋਵੇਗਾ ਕਿ ਜਿਸ ਥਾਂ ਨੂੰ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਚੁਣਨਗੇ ਕਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਮ ਉੱਥੇ ਵਸਾਉਣ, ਉੱਥੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਉਹ ਸਭ ਲਿਆਉਣਾ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਮੈਂ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਹੁਕਮ ਦਿੰਦਾ ਹਾਂ: ਆਪਣੀਆਂ ਹੋਮ ਬਲੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਆਪਣੀਆਂ ਬਲੀਆਂ, ਆਪਣੇ ਦਸਵੰਧ ਅਤੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਹੱਥ ਦੀ ਚੁੱਕਣ ਦੀ ਭੇਟ, ਅਤੇ ਆਪਣੀਆਂ ਸੁੱਖਣਾ ਦੀਆਂ ਸਾਰੀਆਂ ਚੋਣਵੀਆਂ ਭੇਟਾਂ ਜਿਹੜੀਆਂ ਤੁਸੀਂ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਲਈ ਸੁੱਖਦੇ ਹੋ।
pa.B: ਤਾਂ ਜਿਸ ਥਾਂ ਨੂੰ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਨਾਮ ਦੇ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਲਈ ਚੁਣਨਗੇ, ਉੱਥੇ ਉਹ ਸਭ ਕੁਝ ਲਿਆਓ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਹੁਕਮ ਮੈਂ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਦਿੰਦਾ ਹਾਂ: ਆਪਣੀਆਂ ਹੋਮ ਬਲੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਹੋਰ ਬਲੀਆਂ, ਆਪਣੇ ਦਸਵੰਧ ਅਤੇ ਅਲੱਗ ਰੱਖੀਆਂ ਭੇਟਾਂ, ਅਤੇ ਉਹ ਸਾਰੀਆਂ ਉੱਤਮ ਭੇਟਾਂ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਤੁਸੀਂ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਅੱਗੇ ਸੁੱਖਣਾ ਸੁੱਖੀ ਹੋਵੇ।
pa.R: ਤਦ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਇੱਕ ਥਾਂ ਚੁਣਨਗੇ ਜਿੱਥੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਵੱਸੇਗਾ। ਮੇਰੇ ਦੱਸੇ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਸਾਰੀਆਂ ਚੀਜ਼ਾਂ ਉੱਥੇ ਲਿਆਓ: ਆਪਣੀਆਂ ਹੋਮ ਬਲੀਆਂ, ਹੋਰ ਬਲੀਆਂ, ਆਪਣੀ ਉਪਜ ਦਾ ਦਸਵਾਂ ਹਿੱਸਾ, ਖ਼ਾਸ ਭੇਟਾਂ, ਅਤੇ ਉਹ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵਧੀਆ ਚੀਜ਼ਾਂ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਦੇਣ ਦੀ ਤੁਸੀਂ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਅੱਗੇ ਸੁੱਖਣਾ ਸੁੱਖੀ ਹੈ।

decisions.choice: to make his name dwell there: to make the place the home of his name
decisions.reason: The verb "dwell" is the one from which the word for the tabernacle comes. As in verse 5, God's name living at the place means that he is present there for his people and claims the place as his own.

decisions.choice: I am commanding you: Moses speaks
decisions.reason: "I" is Moses, who passes on the commands God gave him (5:31). The same phrase recurs in verses 14, 21 and 28.

decisions.choice: all the choice of your vows: your vow offerings, which are to be the best
alternatives: the best of your vow offerings
decisions.reason: "Choice" means the best, the pick of the flock or harvest. The phrase may mean that vow offerings must be the finest one has, or simply call all vow offerings "choice" gifts. Either way nothing poor is to be vowed to God (Leviticus 22:18-21; Malachi 1:14).

decisions.choice: the list of offerings: as in verse 6
decisions.reason: The list repeats verse 6 in shorter form. See the notes there.

decisions.choice: you are to bring everything ... to the place
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names the place first and then says "there you shall bring". Balanced and Readable put the verb first, as English prefers. Literal keeps the Hebrew order.

decisions.choice: "pour y faire demeurer son nom"
decisions.reason: "Demeurer" is the verb behind "la Demeure" (the tabernacle), as the Hebrew verb is behind the word for the tabernacle; used for this formula throughout Deuteronomy.

decisions.choice: "kulifanya jina lake likae huko"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the verb "dwell" ("kukaa"); verse 5's "put" is "kuweka". Balanced says "kuwa makao ya jina lake" (to be the home of his name), Readable "ili jina lake likae huko".

decisions.choice: para fazer habitar ali o seu nome (L); como habitação para o seu nome (B); como morada para o seu nome (R)
decisions.reason: The second form of the formula (m1), set for the whole book at verse 5 and 14:23.

decisions.choice: "እንዲህም ይሆናል፤" (L) for "and it shall be"; Balanced and Readable say "then" ("በዚያን ጊዜ", "ከዚያም")
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew opening formula; the other levels join it to verse 10 as the English does.

decisions.choice: "使{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}的名居住在那里" (L); "作为{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}名的居所" (B); "让{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}的名住在那里" (R)
decisions.reason: "To make his name dwell there" is a different phrase from "to put his name there" (verse 5); each keeps its own wording at Literal, with "居住" for "dwell" (m1).

decisions.choice: "patahanin doon ang kaniyang pangalan" (L); "tahanan ng kaniyang pangalan" (B, R)
decisions.reason: To make the place the home of his name (m1).

decisions.choice: "iniuutos ko"
decisions.reason: Moses speaks (m2).

decisions.choice: "ang lahat ng pinakamainam sa inyong mga panata" (L); "piling handog" (B); "pinakamainam" (R)
decisions.reason: Your vow offerings, which are to be the best (m3).

decisions.choice: the list of offerings
decisions.reason: As in verse 6 (m4); the order follows English (en1).

source.text: וּשְׂמַחְתֶּ֗ם לִפְנֵי֮ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֒ אַתֶּ֗ם וּבְנֵיכֶם֙ וּבְנֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וְעַבְדֵיכֶ֖ם וְאַמְהֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וְהַלֵּוִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּשַֽׁעֲרֵיכֶ֔ם כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין ל֛וֹ חֵ֥לֶק וְנַחֲלָ֖ה אִתְּכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And you shall rejoice before Yahweh your God, you and your sons and your daughters and your male slaves and your female slaves, and the Levite who [is] in your gates, for there is not to him portion and inheritance with you.

en.L: And you shall rejoice before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, you and your sons and your daughters and your male slaves and your female slaves, and the Levite who [is] within your gates, for he has no portion or inheritance with you.
en.B: And you shall rejoice in the presence of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, you and your sons and daughters, your male and female servants, and the Levite who lives in your towns, since he has no share or inheritance among you.
en.R: Celebrate there in front of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, together with your sons and daughters, your servants, and the Levites who live in your towns. The Levites have not been given land of their own as you have.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:se alegrarán|os alegraréis}} delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y {{plural_you:sus hijos y sus hijas, y sus esclavos y sus esclavas|vuestros hijos y vuestras hijas, y vuestros esclavos y vuestras esclavas}}, y el levita que [está] dentro de {{plural_you:sus puertas|vuestras puertas}}, porque no tiene parte ni heredad con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.B: Y {{plural_you:se alegrarán|os alegraréis}} en presencia {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, {{plural_you:sus hijos y sus hijas, sus siervos y sus siervas|vuestros hijos y vuestras hijas, vuestros siervos y vuestras siervas}}, y el levita que vive en {{plural_you:sus ciudades|vuestras ciudades}}, ya que él no tiene parte ni heredad entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Celebren|Celebrad}} allí delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} junto con {{plural_you:sus hijos e hijas, sus siervos|vuestros hijos e hijas, vuestros siervos}} y los levitas que viven en {{plural_you:sus ciudades|vuestras ciudades}}. A los levitas no se les ha dado tierra propia como a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.

fr.L: Et vous vous réjouirez devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu, vous et vos fils et vos filles, et vos esclaves hommes et vos esclaves femmes, et le Lévite qui [est] dans vos portes, car il n’a ni part ni héritage avec vous.
fr.B: Et vous vous réjouirez en présence {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} votre Dieu, vous, vos fils et vos filles, vos serviteurs et vos servantes, ainsi que le Lévite qui vit dans vos villes, puisqu’il n’a ni part ni héritage parmi vous.
fr.R: Faites la fête là-bas devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu, avec vos fils et vos filles, vos serviteurs et vos servantes, et les Lévites qui vivent dans vos villes. Les Lévites n’ont pas reçu de terre à eux, comme vous en avez reçu.

sw.L: Nanyi mtafurahi mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, ninyi na wana wenu na binti zenu, na watumwa wenu wa kiume na watumwa wenu wa kike, na Mlawi aliye katika malango yenu, kwa maana yeye hana fungu wala urithi pamoja nanyi.
sw.B: Nanyi mtafurahi mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, ninyi pamoja na wana wenu na binti zenu, watumishi wenu wa kiume na wa kike, na Mlawi anayeishi katika miji yenu, kwa kuwa yeye hana fungu wala urithi miongoni mwenu.
sw.R: Shangilieni huko mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu pamoja na wana wenu na binti zenu, watumishi wenu, na Walawi wanaoishi katika miji yenu. Walawi hawakupewa nchi yao wenyewe kama ninyi.

vi.L: Các ngươi sẽ vui mừng trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi, các ngươi cùng con trai, con gái, đầy tớ nam, đầy tớ nữ của các ngươi, và người Lê-vi ở trong các cổng thành các ngươi, vì người ấy không có phần hay sản nghiệp với các ngươi.
vi.B: Anh em sẽ vui mừng trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, anh em cùng con trai, con gái, đầy tớ nam, đầy tớ nữ của mình, và người Lê-vi sống trong các thành của anh em, vì người Lê-vi không có phần hay sản nghiệp giữa anh em.
vi.R: Hãy vui mừng tại đó trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, cùng với con trai, con gái, các đầy tớ của anh em, và những người Lê-vi sống trong các thành của anh em. Người Lê-vi không được chia đất riêng như anh em.

ko.L: 그리고 너희는 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 즐거워하여라. 너희와 너희 아들들과 너희 딸들과 너희 남종들과 너희 여종들과, 너희 성문 안에 있는 레위인도 [즐거워하여라]. 그에게는 너희와 함께 받은 몫이나 유산이 없기 때문이다.
ko.B: 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 너희와 너희 아들딸들과 남종과 여종과, 너희 성읍에 사는 레위인이 함께 즐거워하여라. 레위인은 너희 가운데서 받은 몫이나 유산이 없기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그곳 여러분의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 여러분의 아들딸들과 종들과, 여러분의 성읍에 사는 레위인들과 함께 즐거워하십시오. 레위인들은 여러분처럼 자기 땅을 받지 않았기 때문입니다.

pt.L: E se alegrarão diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, vocês, e os seus filhos, e as suas filhas, e os seus escravos, e as suas escravas, e o levita que [está] dentro das suas portas, pois ele não tem porção nem herança com vocês.
pt.B: E vocês se alegrarão na presença {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, vocês, os seus filhos e as suas filhas, os seus servos e as suas servas, e o levita que vive nas cidades de vocês, já que ele não tem porção nem herança entre vocês.
pt.R: Façam festa ali diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, junto com os seus filhos e as suas filhas, os seus servos e servas e os levitas que vivem nas cidades de vocês. Os levitas não receberam terra própria como vocês receberam.

am.L: በአምላካችሁም {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት ደስ ይላችኋል፤ እናንተና ወንዶች ልጆቻችሁ፣ ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁም፣ ወንዶች ባሪያዎቻችሁና ሴቶች ባሪያዎቻችሁም፣ በደጆቻችሁም ውስጥ ያለው ሌዋዊ፤ እርሱ ከእናንተ ጋር ድርሻና ርስት የለውምና።
am.B: እናንተ፣ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁ፣ ወንዶችና ሴቶች አገልጋዮቻችሁ፣ በከተሞቻችሁም የሚኖረው ሌዋዊ በአምላካችሁ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት ደስ ይበላችሁ፤ እርሱ በመካከላችሁ ድርሻም ሆነ ርስት የለውምና።
am.R: ከወንዶችና ከሴቶች ልጆቻችሁ፣ ከአገልጋዮቻችሁና በከተሞቻችሁ ከሚኖሩት ሌዋውያን ጋር በዚያ በአምላካችሁ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት ደስ ይበላችሁ። ሌዋውያን እንደ እናንተ የራሳቸው መሬት አልተሰጣቸውም።

hi.L: और तुम {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर के सामने आनंद करना, तुम और तुम्हारे पुत्र और तुम्हारी पुत्रियाँ और तुम्हारे दास और तुम्हारी दासियाँ, और वह लेवी जो तुम्हारे फाटकों के भीतर [रहता है], क्योंकि तुम्हारे साथ उसका कोई भाग या निज भाग नहीं है।
hi.B: और तुम {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर के सामने आनंद करना, तुम और तुम्हारे बेटे-बेटियाँ, तुम्हारे दास-दासियाँ, और वह लेवी जो तुम्हारे नगरों में रहता है, क्योंकि तुम्हारे बीच उसका कोई हिस्सा या निज भाग नहीं है।
hi.R: वहाँ {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर के सामने अपने बेटे-बेटियों, अपने दास-दासियों और अपने नगरों में रहनेवाले लेवियों के साथ आनंद मनाना। लेवियों को तुम्हारी तरह अपनी ज़मीन नहीं दी गई है।

ru.L: И веселитесь пред {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}}, вашим Богом, вы, и ваши сыновья, и ваши дочери, и ваши рабы, и ваши рабыни, и левит, который в ваших воротах, потому что нет у него части и надела с вами.
ru.B: И радуйтесь перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}}, вашим Богом, вы, ваши сыновья и дочери, ваши рабы и рабыни, и левит, который живёт в ваших городах, ведь у него нет доли и удела среди вас.
ru.R: Празднуйте там перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}}, вашим Богом, вместе со своими сыновьями и дочерьми, своими рабами и рабынями и левитами, которые живут в ваших городах. Ведь левиты не получили своей земли, как вы.

ja.L: そしてあなたがたは、あなたがたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の前で喜ばなければならない。あなたがたと、あなたがたの息子たちと、あなたがたの娘たちと、あなたがたの男奴隷と、あなたがたの女奴隷と、あなたがたの門の内にいるレビ人も。彼には、あなたがたと共に受ける分も嗣業もないからである。
ja.B: あなたがたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の前で、あなたがたも、息子や娘も、男女の召し使いも、町に住むレビ人も、共に喜びなさい。レビ人には、あなたがたの間で受ける分も嗣業もないからである。
ja.R: あなたたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の前で、息子や娘、召し使いたち、また町に住んでいるレビ人たちと一緒に、喜び祝いなさい。レビ人たちは、あなたたちのように自分の土地をもらっていないのだ。

uk.L: І радійте перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}}, вашим Богом, ви, і ваші сини, і ваші дочки, і ваші раби, і ваші рабині, і левит, що в ваших брамах, бо немає в нього частки і спадку з вами.
uk.B: І радійте перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}}, вашим Богом, ви, ваші сини й дочки, ваші раби й рабині, і левит, що живе у ваших містах, бо він не має частки чи спадку серед вас.
uk.R: Святкуйте там перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}}, вашим Богом, разом зі своїми синами й дочками, рабами й левитами, які живуть у ваших містах. Левити не отримали своєї землі, як ви.

id.L: Dan bersukacitalah di hadapan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah kalian, kalian dan anak-anak kalian laki-laki dan anak-anak kalian perempuan, dan budak-budak kalian laki-laki dan budak-budak kalian perempuan, dan orang Lewi yang di dalam gerbang-gerbang kalian, sebab ia tidak mendapat bagian dan milik pusaka bersama-sama kalian.
id.B: Bersukacitalah di hadapan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah kalian, kalian dan anak-anak kalian laki-laki dan perempuan, hamba-hamba kalian laki-laki dan perempuan, dan orang Lewi yang tinggal di kota-kota kalian, sebab ia tidak mendapat bagian atau milik pusaka di antara kalian.
id.R: Bergembiralah di sana di hadapan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah kalian, bersama anak-anak kalian laki-laki dan perempuan, hamba-hamba kalian, dan orang Lewi yang tinggal di kota-kota kalian. Orang Lewi tidak diberi tanah sendiri seperti kalian.

zh.L: 你们要在{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你们的{{god_term:神|上帝}}面前欢喜，你们和你们的儿子、你们的女儿、你们的奴隶、你们的女奴，以及住在你们城门里的利未人，因为他在你们中间没有分，也没有产业。
zh.B: 你们和你们的儿女、男仆女仆，以及住在你们城镇里的利未人，都要在{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你们的{{god_term:神|上帝}}面前欢喜，因为利未人在你们中间没有分，也没有产业。
zh.R: 你们要和你们的儿女、仆人，以及住在你们城镇里的利未人，一起在{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你们的{{god_term:神|上帝}}面前庆祝。利未人不像你们那样分得自己的土地。

tl.L: At magagalak kayo sa harap {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos, kayo at ang inyong mga anak na lalaki at ang inyong mga anak na babae at ang inyong mga aliping lalaki at ang inyong mga aliping babae, at ang Levitang nasa loob ng inyong mga pintuang-bayan, sapagkat wala siyang bahagi o mana na kasama ninyo.
tl.B: At magagalak kayo sa harap {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos, kayo at ang inyong mga anak na lalaki at babae, ang inyong mga aliping lalaki at babae, at ang Levitang naninirahan sa inyong mga bayan, sapagkat wala siyang bahagi o mana na kasama ninyo.
tl.R: Magdiwang kayo roon sa harap {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos, kasama ng inyong mga anak na lalaki at babae, ng inyong mga alipin, at ng mga Levitang naninirahan sa inyong mga bayan. Hindi binigyan ang mga Levita ng sariling lupain gaya ninyo.

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਆਪਣੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਦੇ ਅੱਗੇ ਅਨੰਦ ਕਰਨਾ, ਤੁਸੀਂ ਅਤੇ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਪੁੱਤਰ ਅਤੇ ਤੁਹਾਡੀਆਂ ਧੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਦਾਸ ਅਤੇ ਤੁਹਾਡੀਆਂ ਦਾਸੀਆਂ, ਅਤੇ ਉਹ ਲੇਵੀ ਜਿਹੜਾ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਫਾਟਕਾਂ ਦੇ ਅੰਦਰ [ਹੈ], ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਨਾਲ ਉਸ ਦਾ ਕੋਈ ਹਿੱਸਾ ਜਾਂ ਮੀਰਾਸ ਨਹੀਂ।
pa.B: ਅਤੇ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਆਪਣੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਦੀ ਹਜ਼ੂਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ੀ ਮਨਾਓ, ਤੁਸੀਂ, ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਪੁੱਤਰ-ਧੀਆਂ, ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਦਾਸ-ਦਾਸੀਆਂ, ਅਤੇ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਨਗਰਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਰਹਿਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਲੇਵੀ, ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਕੋਈ ਹਿੱਸਾ ਜਾਂ ਮੀਰਾਸ ਨਹੀਂ ਮਿਲੀ।
pa.R: ਉੱਥੇ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਆਪਣੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਦੇ ਸਾਹਮਣੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਪੁੱਤਰਾਂ, ਧੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਦਾਸ-ਦਾਸੀਆਂ ਨਾਲ ਮਿਲ ਕੇ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ੀ ਮਨਾਓ। ਆਪਣੇ ਨਗਰਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਰਹਿੰਦੇ ਲੇਵੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਵੀ ਸੱਦੋ, ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਕੋਲ ਆਪਣੀ ਕੋਈ ਜ਼ਮੀਨ ਨਹੀਂ।

decisions.choice: male slaves and female slaves: men and women owned by the household
decisions.reason: These were people owned by a household, not hired workers. They share in the feast with the family, as in the Sabbath law (5:14) and the feasts (16:11, 14).

decisions.choice: within your gates: in your towns
decisions.reason: A town was entered through its gate, and "your gates" stands for the towns of Israel where people live.

decisions.choice: no portion or inheritance: the Levites received no tribal land
decisions.reason: The tribe of Levi was given towns to live in but no territory of its own; it lived from the offerings and tithes (10:9; 18:1-2; Numbers 18:20-24). That is why the Levite must be invited to the feast. "The Levite" stands for every Levite.

decisions.choice: servants
decisions.reason: Literal says "slaves"; Balanced and Readable say "servants", as the style guide sets for this word, while the meaning decision keeps the person's position.

decisions.choice: the Levites (plural)
decisions.reason: Readable says "the Levites", since the singular means the Levites as a group, and says "land of their own" for "portion or inheritance".

decisions.choice: "đầy tớ nam, đầy tớ nữ" for male and female slaves
decisions.reason: As Exodus 20:10 and the term sheet ("đầy tớ" for ʿeved in the household); Literal too, since "đầy tớ" covers a slave who belongs to the house.

decisions.choice: "남종과 여종" (L, B); "종들" (R); "레위인"
decisions.reason: "종" as the term sheet sets for household servants; "노예" stays for slavery in Egypt.

decisions.choice: escravos, escravas (L); servos, servas (B, R); dentro das suas portas (L), nas cidades de vocês (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Escravo" (L) and "servo" (B, R) as the Pentateuch terms set them for this word, as the English does (r-en-1); "your gates" is "as tuas portas" at Literal and the towns at Balanced and Readable, as 14:21 sets it (m2).

decisions.choice: "ባሪያ" (L), "አገልጋይ" (B, R) for the household slaves; "በደጆቻችሁ ውስጥ" (L), "በከተሞቻችሁ" (B, R) for "within your gates"
decisions.reason: The terms list for ʿeved, and Exodus 20:10 in Amharic for the gates; the meaning decision says the gates are the towns.

decisions.choice: "दास-दासियाँ" at every level
decisions.reason: The male and female slaves are men and women owned by the household (m1). As in the New Testament and the note for the Pentateuch, Hindi keeps "दास" at every level, where the English Balanced and Readable say "servants"; the household's slaves share in the feast.

decisions.choice: "तुम्हारे फाटकों के भीतर" (L); "तुम्हारे नगरों में" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Within your gates means in your towns (m2). Literal keeps the Hebrew picture; Balanced and Readable say what it means. The same through the book.

decisions.choice: "рабы и рабыни"
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch note keeps "раб" for ʿeved at every level, as the New Testament does (m1); the English Balanced and Readable say "servants", but Russian follows the note.

decisions.choice: "в ваших воротах" (L); "в ваших городах" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Within your gates" means in your towns (m2). Literal keeps the gates, as in Exodus 20:10 in this translation; Balanced and Readable say towns. The same holds through these chapters.

decisions.choice: male and female slaves "男奴隷", "女奴隷" (Literal), "男女の召し使い" (Balanced), "召し使い" (Readable), as DEU 5:14; "within your gates" "門の内" (Literal), "町" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Follows the English per level and the forms of DEU 5; the gates stand for the towns.

decisions.choice: "奴隶", "女奴" (L); "男仆女仆" (B); "仆人" (R)
decisions.reason: The glossary's words for slaves: "奴隶" at Literal, "仆人" at Balanced and Readable, as the English (m1).

decisions.choice: "城门里" (L); "城镇里" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Within your gates" means in your towns (m2): Literal keeps the gates, Balanced and Readable say towns.

decisions.choice: "mga aliping lalaki ... babae" (L, B); "mga alipin" (R)
decisions.reason: Men and women owned by the household (m1), as English (en1).

decisions.choice: "sa loob ng inyong mga pintuang-bayan" (L); "sa inyong mga bayan" (B, R)
decisions.reason: In your towns (m2).

decisions.choice: "walang bahagi o mana"; "mga Levita" (R)
decisions.reason: The Levites received no tribal land (m3), as English (en2).

source.text: הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְךָ֔ פֶּֽן־תַּעֲלֶ֖ה עֹלֹתֶ֑יךָ בְּכָל־מָק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּרְאֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Take heed to yourself lest you offer up your burnt offerings in every place which you see,

en.L: Take care for yourself that you do not offer up your burnt offerings in every place that you see,
en.B: Be careful not to offer your burnt offerings at any place you happen to see,
en.R: Be careful! Do not offer your burnt offerings just anywhere you like.

es.L: Guárdate a ti mismo de ofrecer tus holocaustos en cualquier lugar que veas,
es.B: Ten cuidado de no ofrecer tus holocaustos en cualquier lugar que encuentres a tu paso,
es.R: ¡Ten cuidado! No ofrezcas tus holocaustos donde a ti te parezca.

fr.L: Prends garde à toi, de peur que tu n’offres tes holocaustes en tout lieu que tu verras,
fr.B: Garde-toi d’offrir tes holocaustes en n’importe quel lieu qui se présente à tes yeux,
fr.R: Fais attention ! N’offre pas tes holocaustes n’importe où, là où il te plaît.

sw.L: Jihadhari nafsi yako usije ukatoa sadaka zako za kuteketezwa katika kila mahali utakapopaona,
sw.B: Jihadhari usitoe sadaka zako za kuteketezwa mahali popote utakapopaona,
sw.R: Kuwa mwangalifu! Usitoe sadaka zako za kuteketezwa mahali popote unapopenda.

vi.L: Hãy giữ mình, kẻo ngươi dâng các của lễ thiêu của ngươi tại bất cứ nơi nào ngươi thấy,
vi.B: Hãy thận trọng, đừng dâng của lễ thiêu tại bất cứ nơi nào anh em tình cờ thấy,
vi.R: Hãy cẩn thận! Đừng dâng của lễ thiêu ở bất cứ nơi nào anh em thích.

ko.L: 너는 스스로 조심하여, 네가 보는 아무 곳에서나 네 번제물을 바치지 말아라.
ko.B: 너희 눈에 띄는 아무 곳에서나 번제물을 바치지 않도록 조심하여라.
ko.R: 조심하십시오! 아무 데서나 마음대로 번제물을 바치지 마십시오.

pt.L: Guarda-te para que não ofereças os teus holocaustos em qualquer lugar que vires,
pt.B: Toma cuidado para não oferecer os teus holocaustos em qualquer lugar que vires,
pt.R: Toma cuidado! Não ofereças os teus holocaustos em qualquer lugar que quiseres.

am.L: በምታየው ስፍራ ሁሉ የሚቃጠሉ መሥዋዕቶችህን እንዳታቀርብ ለራስህ ተጠንቀቅ፤
am.B: ባገኘኸው ስፍራ ሁሉ የሚቃጠሉ መሥዋዕቶችህን እንዳታቀርብ ተጠንቀቅ፤
am.R: ተጠንቀቅ! የሚቃጠሉ መሥዋዕቶችህን ደስ ባለህ ቦታ ሁሉ አታቅርብ።

hi.L: अपने आप से सावधान रहना कि तुम अपनी होमबलियाँ हर उस स्थान पर न चढ़ाओ जिसे तुम देखो,
hi.B: सावधान रहना कि तुम अपनी होमबलियाँ किसी भी ऐसे स्थान पर न चढ़ाओ जो तुम्हें दिख जाए,
hi.R: सावधान रहना! अपनी होमबलियाँ जहाँ चाहो वहाँ न चढ़ाना।

ru.L: Остерегайся, чтобы не приносить твоих всесожжений во всяком месте, которое увидишь,
ru.B: Смотри, не приноси своих всесожжений в любом месте, какое тебе попадётся,
ru.R: Будь осторожен! Не приноси свои всесожжения где попало.

ja.L: あなたは自分自身に気をつけ、あなたが見るあらゆる場所で、あなたの焼き尽くすささげ物をささげることのないようにしなさい。
ja.B: 目についた場所ならどこででも焼き尽くすささげ物をささげることのないように、気をつけなさい。
ja.R: 気をつけなさい。焼いてささげるいけにえを、自分の好きな所でささげてはいけない。

uk.L: Стережися, щоб ти не приносив твоїх всепалень у кожному місці, яке побачиш,
uk.B: Стережися, щоб не приносити свої всепалення в будь-якому місці, яке тобі трапиться,
uk.R: Будь обережний! Не приноси своїх всепалень будь-де, де тобі заманеться.

id.L: Berhati-hatilah, supaya jangan engkau mempersembahkan korban-korban bakaranmu di setiap tempat yang kaulihat,
id.B: Berhati-hatilah, supaya engkau tidak mempersembahkan korban bakaranmu di sembarang tempat yang kaulihat,
id.R: Berhati-hatilah! Jangan mempersembahkan korban bakaran kalian di sembarang tempat yang kalian sukai.

zh.L: 你要为自己谨慎，不可在你所看见的任何地方献你的燔祭；
zh.B: 你要小心，不可在你随便看到的任何地方献燔祭，
zh.R: 你要小心！不要随意在你喜欢的地方献全烧的祭。

tl.L: Mag-ingat ka na hindi mo ihandog ang iyong mga handog na sinusunog sa bawat lugar na iyong makita,
tl.B: Mag-ingat kayo na huwag ihandog ang inyong mga handog na sinusunog sa alinmang lugar na inyong makita,
